v: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge; who subdues my people under me.
b: This verse deeply shows God's lovingkindness and protection toward us. He is the Lord on whom we can rely completely in danger. His lovingkindness is like a solid fortress that shelters us in hardship; He is our high tower, letting us see far and discern the direction of life; He is our deliverer, standing against temptation and danger for us; He is our shield, protecting us from harm. In God's lovingkindness we find not only comfort but also strength to keep going.

This lovingkindness is like a guardian who is never absent. Wherever we are, He is always beside us, ready at any moment to help. Whether we face the surging waves of life or its silent valleys, God's lovingkindness shines as bright as the stars, lighting the road ahead.

There was a brother named Zhang Weiming whose life once fell into a low point. The shadow of unemployment hung over his family, leaving him helpless and in despair. At his hardest moment he returned to God and began to read Scripture and pray every day. In one devotional time Weiming read this verse and was deeply moved. He began to realize that however hard his circumstances were, God's lovingkindness still surrounded him and was a refuge he could rely on completely.

After that, Weiming chose to trust God's leading and, with that faith, worked hard to find a job. After a while he found a suitable position and witnessed God's faithfulness in the new environment. Weiming often said, "If it were not for the protection of God's lovingkindness, I might have given up, but God's lovingkindness was like a fortress that gave me the courage to start again."

Zhang Weiming's story shows us that God's lovingkindness is what we rely on all our lives. Whatever difficulty we meet, He is always our shield and deliverer. When we take refuge in Him with all our hearts, His lovingkindness becomes a firm strength in our lives.

Dear family, let us remember that God's lovingkindness is our eternal fortress and high tower, and His shield protects us at all times so that we do not fall. May we learn each day to rely completely on God's lovingkindness and pass this lovingkindness on to others.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God is not only the Lord of lovingkindness but also our protection, deliverance, and refuge. We can respond to this lovingkindness in life in the following concrete, practical, and creative ways:
a: A Haven of Lovingkindness
Provide a warm space for family or friends, whether a sincere listening ear or a hearty meal, letting them feel God's lovingkindness reaching their lives through you.
A Stone of Faith and Reliance

Find a smooth stone and write on it "Lord of Lovingkindness" or another phrase of your faith in God. Put it on your desk or carry it with you to remind yourself to take refuge daily in this Lord of lovingkindness.
Shield Prayer
Each morning pray over the day's challenges, asking God to be your shield and keep you from temptation and danger, and in the evening give thanks again, recalling how He guarded your steps.
Fortress Plan
Build a spiritual refuge, whether a personal quiet time or worship with your family, and let this space be the high tower where you meet God every day.
Acts of Deliverance

Take part in community service or relief efforts, giving help to people in need, from a meal to a word of encouragement, becoming an extension of God's lovingkindness so that they see how God saves with lovingkindness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being our Lord of lovingkindness, our fortress, high tower, and shield. In life You keep protecting, delivering, and comforting us. Please help us share this lovingkindness with the people around us, be Your witnesses, and let more people know You are the Lord they can take refuge in. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find comfort and hope in God's lovingkindness and, under His keeping, face all of life's challenges with courage. Amen!

v: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, “Return, backsliding Israel,” says Yahweh; “I will not look in anger on you; for I am merciful,” says Yahweh, “I will not keep anger forever.”
b: This verse shows God's endless lovingkindness and forbearance toward His people. Even though Israel turned away from His ways again and again, God still called them back with lovingkindness. He does not want to punish for long or keep us at a distance, but waits for us to repent and return to His embrace. This reveals a loving Heavenly Father whose anger lasts only a moment, but whose lovingkindness lasts forever.

God's lovingkindness is like a lighthouse by the sea. However far we drift off course, the light shines steadily, guiding us back to a safe harbor. No matter how far we have gone, as long as we turn back, God is always waiting for us.

There was a sister named Li Ruofan who, in her youth, because of the pressures of life and her confusion, gradually drifted away from church and began to live relying on her own ways. But this choice did not bring her the happiness she wanted; instead she felt lonelier and lonelier. She always felt that her turning away had disappointed God, and even thought she no longer deserved His love.

One day, by chance, Ruofan heard this verse, and it was as if God Himself were speaking to her: "Return. I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful." Those words touched her heart. She gathered her courage, went back to church, confessed her sin to God, and resolved to pursue her relationship with Him anew. After that she deeply experienced God's love, and she often said, "God's lovingkindness is like a pair of warm hands. However many times I fall, He is willing to lift me up again."

Li Ruofan's story tells us that however we have failed or strayed in the past, God's lovingkindness is always waiting for us to return. He does not hold on to anger, nor does He count our transgressions. As long as we sincerely repent, He is willing to welcome us with lovingkindness.

Dear family, let us remember that God is merciful, and His heart longs for us to return before Him. May we find peace and strength in His lovingkindness every day and bring this lovingkindness to the people around us.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God's lovingkindness is unconditional, and He longs for us to repent and return to His embrace. In life we too can learn God's lovingkindness and put this selfless love into practice in the following ways:
a: Acceptance Plan
If someone around you has offended or hurt you, try reaching out to be reconciled, letting that person feel unconditional acceptance, just as God called backsliding Israel to return.
Love Cards
Write a card or short message to encourage friends or family who you feel may be struggling, reminding them that God is merciful and they need not be afraid to return before Him.
Training in Forbearance
Practice losing your temper less in daily life. When you feel anger, stop and meditate on this verse, learn God's attitude of not holding anger forever, and respond calmly.
Passing On Lovingkindness
Plan a family or group activity to share how God has shown lovingkindness in your lives, and pray together to share this love with people in need.
Acts of Repentance

Spend a few minutes each day quietly reflecting on your faults, confessing to God and thanking Him for His forgiveness; also learn to forgive yourself or others, letting God's lovingkindness flow into your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for treating us with lovingkindness. Even when we are weak and fall, You still gently call us to return. Please help us learn Your lovingkindness, so that we too may accept and forgive others, become channels of Your grace, and bring more people back to Your embrace. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often receive comfort and forgiveness in God's lovingkindness and, by His grace, live a life full of peace. Amen!

v: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
b: This verse reminds us that lovingkindness is an attribute of God, and His righteous judgment is inseparable from His lovingkindness. God not only repays each person justly according to what he has done but also, in His lovingkindness, extends grace and gives people the chance to repent. God's lovingkindness is not only a comfort to us but also the power that leads us to walk the right path.

God's lovingkindness is like a judge who is also a father. Although His judgment is just, His heart is always full of compassion, hoping that each of His children will choose the upright way. His judgment is not only for punishment but also to lead us toward spiritual growth.

There was a brother named Chen Jianzhong who went through a time of turning away from God. Out of greed for momentary gain he chose dishonest conduct, was finally found out, and even lost his steady job. In deep remorse he read this verse. He understood that the consequences he faced were God's righteous repayment, but he also realized that God's lovingkindness had not left him. Jianzhong resolved to take up honesty and integrity again and to repent before God. As time passed, he not only found a new job but also became a model of integrity in his company.

Jianzhong's testimony tells us that God's lovingkindness and righteousness exist together. When we make mistakes, He lets us learn the lesson in a righteous way, but His lovingkindness also gives us the chance to repent and be renewed.

Dear family, let us remember that lovingkindness belongs to God. He guides us not only with His righteousness but also upholds us with His lovingkindness. May we, in His grace, strive to live in a way that glorifies His name.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that lovingkindness comes from God, and our conduct will also receive His righteous repayment. We can put this truth into practice in life in the following concrete ways:
a: Daily Thanksgiving
Each day in prayer, review God's lovingkindness and write down at least three things in which you feel His grace, letting gratitude become part of your life.
Giving Lovingkindness
During the day, deliberately choose at least one opportunity to care for someone, whether offering help, saying an encouraging word, or listening to their needs.
Consistency of Word and Deed
Reflect on whether your conduct glorifies God and work to make each day's conduct match God's teaching, showing His lovingkindness and righteousness.
Family Lovingkindness Time
Plan a family activity in which each person shares one strength or one thing they are grateful for in each other, helping you feel God's love flowing in the family.
Community Lovingkindness Day
Join community service, such as visiting a nursing home, distributing food, or helping neighbors in need, putting God's lovingkindness into practice.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being full of lovingkindness and righteousness and for teaching us to act in love. Please help us live out Your lovingkindness every day and witness to Your grace in action, so that more people can see Your radiance. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find comfort in God's lovingkindness, guidance in His righteousness, and live an abundant life in His presence. Amen!

v: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
b: This verse shows the abundant grace of the triune God. Jesus Christ brings the grace of redemption, God brings us into His family with lovingkindness, and the Holy Spirit gives us His prompting and becomes the guide of our lives. God's lovingkindness is the core of these, enabling us to deeply experience the greatness of salvation and the presence of the Holy Spirit.

God's lovingkindness is like a bridge connecting our limited humanity with God's infinite glory. This bridge is not only firm but also full of life, so that we can walk freely into God's embrace and experience His grace and prompting.

There was a sister named Li Wenjuan who felt very lonely while going through a broken family and a low point in life. But in one time of prayer she read this verse and deeply realized that God's lovingkindness surpasses everything. Wenjuan said, "When I felt isolated and helpless, God's lovingkindness became the pillar of my life. His love gave me hope again." Wenjuan began to rebuild her relationship with God and, through the prompting of the Holy Spirit, learned to forgive. In the end her family was amazed at her change and was willing to experience this lovingkindness of God together with her.
Wenjuan's story reminds us that God's lovingkindness lets us not only experience His presence but also become channels of His love, bringing blessing to those around us.

Dear family, let us remember that God's lovingkindness is the core of salvation and the source of strength for our lives. May we experience the grace of the Lord, the lovingkindness of God, and the prompting of the Holy Spirit every day and pass this love on.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God's lovingkindness is with us at every moment and, through the Holy Spirit, moves us to live out love. We can put it into practice in the following ways:

Take the initiative to extend a hand of reconciliation to someone with whom you have a misunderstanding or distance, and let God's lovingkindness close the gap between you.
Gifts of Grace
Prepare some simple gifts to give to people in need, such as lonely elderly people or the disadvantaged in your community, bringing God's grace into their lives.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the grace of the Lord Jesus and the prompting of the Holy Spirit, always with us. Please help us respond to Your love with our lives, walk with others in love, and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive comfort and joy in God's lovingkindness, walk with Him, and be a witness of His love. Amen!

t: The Lovingkindness of the Most High
v: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
b: This verse tells us that relying on God's lovingkindness is the most solid foundation of our lives. The lovingkindness of the Most High is not limited or changeable like human love; His love is never shaken, and it lets us find stability in a turbulent environment. Whether king or commoner, those who rely on God's lovingkindness receive true peace.
God's lovingkindness is like a deep-rooted tree. However fierce the wind and rain, it always stands firm and gives us shade and shelter.

There was a brother named Zhang Zhihao who went through many ups and downs while starting his business. Once his company faced the crisis of bankruptcy because of a mistaken investment, and Zhihao felt very discouraged, even doubting whether he could go on. At his hardest moment he remembered this verse and decided to entrust all his worries to God. He began to seek God's guidance in prayer every day and, relying on God's lovingkindness, readjusted the direction of his company. In the end his company not only got through the crisis but also welcomed new opportunities for growth. In his testimony Zhihao said, "I experienced God's unshaken lovingkindness, and it let me see hope in a dead end."
Zhihao's story reminds us that when we rely on the lovingkindness of the Most High, whatever turbulence is outside, our hearts can find calm and stability.
Dear family, let us remember that God's lovingkindness is the unshakable foundation of our lives. May we rely on His lovingkindness every day and receive peace and joy.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that when we rely on God's lovingkindness, our lives are firm and unshaken. We can put this faith into practice in the following ways:

Acts of Trust
When you face challenges in life, learn to entrust problems to God, replace worry with prayer, and act in belief that He will provide.
Lovingkindness Challenge
Set a goal to challenge yourself to show love and care to a stranger each day, such as saying an encouraging word or helping carry something heavy.
A Firm Home
Set faith goals with your family, such as reading Scripture or praying together daily, so that God's lovingkindness steadies the foundation of the home.
Passing On Love
Teach children or young people about God's lovingkindness, and use your testimony to encourage them to trust the Most High, so that faith is handed down like a torch.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that Your supreme lovingkindness keeps our lives firm and unshaken. Please give us faith to learn to rely on You in difficulty, to serve others with love, and to bring Your lovingkindness to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often receive stability and hope in the lovingkindness of the Most High, and stand firm in any challenge. Amen!

v: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
b: This verse reminds us that God's love is constant and immeasurably rich. His grace is unconditional favor, His mercy is limitless compassion, and His great lovingkindness is an unfathomable depth of affection. This love does not change with whether our conduct is good or bad, because it is simply in His nature to be loving.

It is like the sunshine that covers the earth. Whether or not the sky is cloudy, the sun is always there. God's great lovingkindness is the same: whether or not we feel it, His love is always present, warming our lives.

There was a sister named Zhang Hui whose story fully shows the power of this truth. Zhang Hui once went through a family crisis. Her husband was depressed over a failed investment and gradually cared less for the family, and she herself, under too much stress, came into conflict with her husband and even thought of divorce. Facing these challenges, Zhang Hui chose to stop and return before God, and to learn anew to treat her husband after the pattern of God's lovingkindness.

Zhang Hui decided to express God's grace and mercy in action. Whatever her husband's mood, she prepared meals for him every day and prayed quietly, hoping he would find his direction again. Once, when her husband lost his temper over a small matter, Zhang Hui did not answer with a quarrel but said gently, "I believe you can get through all this, and I will be at your side always." That sentence touched her husband's heart. He began to reflect on his attitude and tried to express his thanks to Zhang Hui. In the end the family rebuilt trust and love in God's great lovingkindness.

Zhang Hui's story shows us that God's great lovingkindness not only changes our lives but can flow out through us and change the people around us. When we are willing to imitate God's lovingkindness in treating others, our lives become channels of God's grace, bringing restoration and blessing.

Dear family, let us remember that God's great lovingkindness is a lasting power, and whatever our situation, His love always leads us toward the light. May we take His lovingkindness as our example and be a reflection of it in every day of our lives.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: God's great lovingkindness is the foundation of our lives, reminding us to show grace and mercy in how we treat others. We can put this lovingkindness into practice through the following concrete actions:
a: Moments of Mercy
Each day notice those around you who need help and offer support on your own initiative, such as comforting a discouraged friend or helping a neighbor finish a task.
Sharing Lovingkindness in the Family
Gather with your family each week to share the lovingkindness of God you have felt in life, and bless and pray for one another.
Anger Management
Learn to replace anger with love and patience when you face conflict, overcoming negative emotions through deep breaths or silent prayer, imitating God's being slow to anger.
Acts of Grace
Plan a charitable project for those in need in the community, such as donating supplies or holding a charity sale, so that God's love reaches more people.
Daily Lovingkindness Reminder
Each morning meditate on God's great love and write down a verse or prayer to encourage yourself, beginning your day with it.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being full of grace and mercy, and for letting us learn Your being slow to anger and great in lovingkindness. Please help us show Your love in life and bring blessing to everyone we meet. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you feel the presence of God's great lovingkindness in every challenge and bless others with His love, making life richer. Amen!

v: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
b: This verse tells us that God shows both His righteousness and His lovingkindness in all His works. Whether or not we can understand His plan, every decision of His carries the nature of righteousness and love. He is not a cold judge but a Father full of lovingkindness; in His righteousness there is mercy, and in His lovingkindness there is wisdom.

It is like a skilled potter who carefully shapes every piece. Every cut or trim he makes, however painful or puzzling it may seem, is meant to bring the work to its most perfect form. In the same way, God's work in our lives may sometimes seem hard to bear, but His motive is always lovingkindness, to accomplish His good purpose in us.

There was a sister named Li Mei whose experience deeply embodies this truth. Li Mei had a steady job but was laid off when her company reorganized. This plunged her into a low point for a time, and she could not understand why God would allow such a thing. But in prayer she felt God's leading, began to learn new skills, and in the end found a job that fit her interests and talents even better. At the same time, this experience made her rely on God more, learn gratitude and trust, and become light and salt, encouraging others in her new job.

Li Mei recalled, "If I had not gone through the setback of unemployment, I might never have seen the better road God had prepared for me." Her testimony helps us understand that God's lovingkindness is in every step of our lives, and even if we cannot see clearly for a while, His hand is always guiding us toward a richer future.

Dear family, let us remember that there is lovingkindness in all God's works, whether or not we understand it now. May we, in every challenge, believe in His righteousness and lovingkindness with faith, and learn from it to rely on Him and praise Him.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: God's lovingkindness and righteousness are shown in all His works, reminding us that in life, in matters great and small, we can act with love and integrity. Here are concrete ways to practice it:
a: Righteous Choices
Choose integrity in daily decisions, for example by supporting ethical brands when shopping, or by handling matters fairly at work without favoring anyone.
Lovingkindness Record
Note down the lovely moments you meet each day, whether scenes in nature or interactions with people, and let lovingkindness become the theme of your life.
Proposals of Love
Work with your team or friends to start impactful activities for disadvantaged groups in the community, such as free classes or fundraising plans.
Consistency of Word and Deed
Practice reflecting God's lovingkindness in both word and action, for example by avoiding complaints and replacing them with words of gratitude.
Family Integrity Day
Set a challenge with your family for one day of no lying, no complaining, and no criticizing, encouraging each other to grow together.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing lovingkindness and righteousness in all that You do. Please help us learn from You in every small thing in life, so that our conduct becomes a witness of love and integrity. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you feel the presence of God's lovingkindness every day and, even in difficulty, be full of hope and experience His abundant grace. Amen!

v: Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; but he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.
b: This verse reveals God's attributes: He is a God abundant in lovingkindness and also a God of righteousness. He is willing to forgive iniquity but will not easily overlook sin. His lovingkindness and righteousness exist together, letting us know that although He is full of compassion toward us, we must not take the seriousness of sin lightly but should respond to His grace with reverence.

It is like parents' love for their child. They are willing to bear with the child's faults, yet they also set rules to correct the child's behavior and guide the child on the right road. In the same way, God's lovingkindness is not indulgence but is meant to lead us away from sin and toward the fullness of life.

There was a brother named Lin Junliang who, out of momentary greed, once broke the rules at work and caused his company a loss. He felt deeply guilty but did not dare face the consequences. Yet in prayer God reminded him that only by admitting his mistake and seeking forgiveness could he be truly free. Junliang gathered his courage, confessed to his supervisor, and took responsibility. Although the process was hard, he also experienced God's abundant lovingkindness: the company forgave his mistake and gave him a chance to put it right. His honesty and repentance in the end won him the respect of his colleagues.
Junliang's experience reminds us that God's abundant lovingkindness forgives our transgressions, but we must also come with reverence, repent sincerely, and change our conduct.

Dear family, let us remember that God is a Lord full of lovingkindness and righteousness. He is glad to forgive and leads us back to the right path with His abundant lovingkindness. May we all find comfort in His lovingkindness and respond to His grace with repentance and obedience.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: God's abundant lovingkindness exists together with His righteousness, reminding us to learn to forgive but also to take responsibility for our wrongs. We can put it into practice in life in the following ways:
a: Practicing Forgiveness
Reflect on past hurts, choose to forgive on your own initiative, and write down the resentment you are willing to release and entrust it to God.
Making Amends with Good Deeds
If you have hurt others, try to make it up with practical action, such as an apology, help, or a thoughtful gift.
Teaching Lovingkindness
Talk with children or young people about the importance of lovingkindness and righteousness, and guide them through examples to learn the right values.
Handing Down Lovingkindness Through Generations
Look back on stories of lovingkindness in your family and pass these experiences on to the next generation, building a culture of gratitude in the home.
A Greeting of Love
Each day give the people around you a word of care or encouragement, and let lovingkindness become a daily habit through simple action.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being full of abundant lovingkindness and righteousness, for forgiving our iniquities and transgressions, yet also teaching us to take responsibility for right and wrong. Please help us live out love and honesty and pass Your love on to more hearts. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's abundant lovingkindness every day and, through His forgiveness and guidance, walk the road of joy and freedom. Amen!

v: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
b: This verse reminds us that God's lovingkindness is the foundation on which we can draw near to Him and worship Him. It is not because of our good deeds or merits, but because of God's abundant lovingkindness that we can come before Him openly and without fear and have fellowship with Him. This lovingkindness brings spiritual privilege and also moves us to respond to Him with reverence and offer Him sincere worship.

It is like a kind king who opens his palace and welcomes his subjects to come and share what is on their hearts. Although he sits in a high position, his love and compassion make people feel warm and close. In the same way, God's lovingkindness lets us draw near to Him and not stay far away because of our weakness or transgressions.

There was a sister named Huang Meiling who stopped praying because she felt unworthy, thinking her past kept her from entering God's presence. But when she read this verse, her heart was deeply touched. She understood that it was God's lovingkindness that let her draw near to Him openly, not her perfection or worthiness. Meiling began to spend time in prayer and worship every day, and in prayer she experienced a peace and joy she had never known. She shared, "God's lovingkindness is my greatest support. The closer I draw to Him, the more I feel His acceptance and grace."
Meiling's testimony reminds us that whatever our past, God's lovingkindness is always open to us. As long as we come before Him with reverence and trust, He is glad to draw near to us.

Dear family, let us remember that God's lovingkindness is the bridge by which we draw near to Him. May we come before Him every day with thankful and reverent hearts and enjoy peace and satisfaction in His presence.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: God's abundant lovingkindness lets us draw near to Him and reminds us to come before Him with a reverent heart. Here are practical ways to act:
a: Morning Prayer of Thanks
Each morning in prayer, thank God for His lovingkindness and entrust the day's plans into His hands.
Worship Time
Choose a worship song and each day sing sincerely of God's lovingkindness and grace, creating an atmosphere of nearness to God.
Meditation in the Temple
Regularly meditate on God's word in a quiet place and sense His presence, as if entering His dwelling.
Acts of Reverence
Reflect on whether your choices honor God, for example by avoiding negative entertainment and choosing beneficial activities.
Walking Together in Fellowship
Join friends or family in worship or devotions, sharing God's lovingkindness and encouraging one another.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your abundant lovingkindness that lets us draw near to You. Please help us worship You with reverent hearts, and let our lives be a witness that glorifies You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, by God's abundant lovingkindness, enter His presence every day and experience His power and grace in worship. Amen!

v: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
b: This verse shows the psalmist’s deep longing for God’s lovingkindness. He believes that God’s lovingkindness is good, and that it brings comfort and strength in times of trouble. This is something each of us can understand: God’s lovingkindness is not only a lovely part of His character, it is also the greatest support we have when we face challenges.

It is like a loving father who is always ready to reach out a hand just when his child needs it most. Even when the child does wrong, the father still embraces and guides him with love. In the same way, when we are weak and in need, God’s lovingkindness becomes our greatest refuge.

There was a brother named Zhao Zhihao who lost his job and his income during a financial crisis, and the pressure on his family nearly broke him. In utter helplessness he knelt and prayed, asking God for help and mercy. A few days later he received a notice for an interview, and in the end he got a new job. Looking back on that time, Zhihao said, “In my loneliest hour, it was God’s lovingkindness that held me up and let me know He would not abandon me.”
Zhihao’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is always a light in our lives. However hard our circumstances may be, His good lovingkindness surrounds us and brings us hope and strength.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is our unchanging assurance. May we seek His help in every difficulty, and find comfort and renewal in His lovingkindness.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow today’s Soul Snack action guide together: God’s lovingkindness is good, and it reminds us to seek His care in hard times and to share this love with others. We can put it into practice in the following ways:
a: Prayer Journal
Each day, write down one thing you asked of God, and record how He answered your prayer, so you can sense His lovingkindness.
Lovingkindness Notes
Write a testimony of God’s lovingkindness on a card or in a letter and share it with someone near you, so they too may be touched by God’s love.
Soul Visits
Visit someone who is lonely or in need, bringing a gift or a word of encouragement, and answer God’s good lovingkindness with action.
Prayer Partners
Form a prayer group with friends and pray for one another’s needs, experiencing God’s answers and lovingkindness together.
Creative Worship
Express your gratitude for God’s lovingkindness through painting, music, or song, and spread the word of His goodness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your good lovingkindness, for answering our cry, and for caring for us with Your abundant mercy. Help us to trust in You in times of difficulty and to show Your love with our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s good lovingkindness in every day of your life, and find in His mercy an eternal refuge and hope. Amen!

v: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
b: This verse shows the psalmist’s deep trust in God in the midst of trouble, as he places his hope in God’s good lovingkindness. It reminds us that, whatever hardship we face, God’s lovingkindness is always the source of our rescue and our refuge. His favor does not rest on our conduct but flows from His own good nature. When we cry out to Him in weakness, He will help us according to His abundant lovingkindness and accomplish for us grace beyond what we ask.

It is like a ship sailing at night that relies on a lighthouse for direction. However dark the sea may be, the light of the lighthouse always brings hope. In the same way, God’s good lovingkindness is the light that guides us in every dark moment of life, helping us find hope and strength again.

There was a sister named Lin Meiping who lost her job and her income during a financial crisis, and the pressure on her family nearly broke her. In utter helplessness she knelt and prayed, asking God for help and mercy. A few days later she received a notice for an interview, and in the end she got a new job. Looking back on that time, Meiping said, “In my loneliest hour, it was God’s lovingkindness that held me up and let me know He would not abandon me.”
Meiping’s story reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is always a light in our lives. However hard our circumstances may be, His good lovingkindness surrounds us and brings us hope and strength.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the assurance and hope of our lives. Whatever challenge we face, we can call on Him boldly, for His lovingkindness is good and He will surely deliver us.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow today’s Soul Snack action guide together: God’s lovingkindness is good, and it is our support and help in times of trouble. Here are some ways we can put it into practice:
a: Daily Gratitude List
Each day, list three things in which you sensed God’s lovingkindness, to remind yourself that His grace is everywhere.
A Time to Cry Out
When you feel troubled or pressured, call out to God right away, trusting that He will deliver you in His lovingkindness.
Share a Story of Love
Share your testimony of God’s lovingkindness with those around you, encouraging them also to lean on God’s love.
Help Those in Trouble
Like God’s lovingkindness, reach out to those near you who need help, and become their support and strength.
A Keepsake of Lovingkindness
Choose your favorite verse about God’s lovingkindness and make it into a handmade card or decoration, a constant reminder that God’s love never ends.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your good lovingkindness, for answering our cry, and for caring for us with Your abundant mercy. Help us to trust in You in times of difficulty and to show Your love with our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s good lovingkindness every day, and in times of ease or hardship alike, sense His grace and support. May you find peace and strength in God’s lovingkindness and live a life full of hope. Amen!

v: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
b: This verse is full of hope. It reminds us that even in desperate circumstances we can survive by God’s lovingkindness. The LORD’s lovingkindness is manifold and abundant, touching every part of our lives. Even when we face trials or pain, His compassion never leaves us and brings us hope and strength. Our lives go on because His unfailing love continues to hold us up and give us new grace.

It is like a mother’s many kinds of care for her child, from food to education, from companionship to encouragement, in matters great and small. The child may not always grasp how deep this love is, but the mother’s love never changes. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness toward us is sometimes comfort, sometimes discipline, and sometimes guidance. We may not fully notice it, but His love has never stopped.

There was a brother named Li Jiarui who lost his steady income during the pandemic, and the burden of life became extremely heavy. Every day he was anxious about his family’s future, but in prayer he took hold of God’s promises again and relied on His lovingkindness and provision. Wonderfully, in the midst of his hardship, a neighbor offered to help him through, and his church prayed for him together and gave practical support. Jiarui came to feel deeply that, whether through people or through direct grace, God’s lovingkindness surrounded him all along. Later he found a new job and life gradually returned to calm. He said, “It was God’s lovingkindness that let me see hope in my most helpless hour, and kept me going.”

Jiarui’s testimony reminds us that the LORD’s lovingkindness is everywhere. It not only rescues us, it also gives us strength and support when we need them most. His compassion does not fail, so we can face each day’s challenges with confidence.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the firmest hope and support in our lives. In good times and bad, let us hold on to this lovingkindness, learn to be thankful, and live this love out.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow today’s Soul Snack action guide together: God’s lovingkindness is manifold and abundant, and it surrounds us at all times. Let us feel and practice His lovingkindness through the following actions:
a: Gratitude Notes
Each day, write down three graces you have received from God, to cultivate a thankful heart and recognize His grace in your life.
Pass On Lovingkindness
Find someone in need and pass on God’s lovingkindness through practical acts such as food, words of encouragement, or the gift of your time.
Prayers of Lovingkindness
Each day, pray for one person in difficulty, asking God’s lovingkindness to come upon their life.
Reminders of Grace
Share with family or friends one experience of how God upheld you with His lovingkindness, and bear witness to His goodness.
Creative Thanksgiving
Express your thanks for all of God’s lovingkindnesses through drawing, poetry, or letters, and share them to inspire others.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for all Your lovingkindnesses, which keep us from being consumed in hard times and hold up our lives with Your compassion. Help us to be thankful always and to share Your love with more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience all of the LORD’s lovingkindnesses in every day of your life. May His compassion be your support and His grace your strength. Amen!

v: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
b: This verse reveals God’s marvelous lovingkindness, which is not only care for people but also a mighty rescue for those who take refuge in Him. God’s lovingkindness is never limited by circumstances. Whatever danger we face, He can save us with His mighty right hand and deliver us from enemies and trouble. His lovingkindness is shown not only in grace but also in His protection of our lives.

It is like a skilled firefighter who, in the midst of a blaze, uses courage and skill to bring trapped people out and lead them away from danger. In the same way, when we take refuge in God, His marvelous lovingkindness and power become, like that firefighter, our rescue in a crisis.

There was a brother named Zhou Zhiwen who once faced a serious business crisis during a financial storm. Because of sharp swings in the market, his investments suffered heavy losses, and not only was his company on the brink of collapse, but his family life was affected too. The pressure was enormous and he did not know what to do. At his most desperate moment he cried out to God in prayer, begging for His marvelous lovingkindness to save him. God heard his prayer, and a former business partner reached out to him on his own and helped him through the crisis. Zhiwen later testified, “In the hardest time I experienced God’s marvelous lovingkindness. He showed me that as long as I take refuge in Him, I will not be struck down.”

Zhou Zhiwen’s experience reminds us that God’s marvelous lovingkindness goes far beyond our imagination. His rescue is everywhere, and if we are willing to take refuge in Him, we can experience His power and lovingkindness.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is marvelous and is the firmest assurance in our lives. In every difficulty, may we choose to take refuge in Him and find peace and strength in His lovingkindness.
a: Record Moments of Grace
Each day, write down the lovingkindness and help of God that you have experienced, to remind yourself of His marvelous works.
The Courage to Seek Help
In difficulty, learn from Zhou Zhiwen to cry out boldly to God, and be willing to receive the help He offers through others.
Become a Rescuer
When you see someone near you who needs help, reach out a hand and become a means through which they experience God’s lovingkindness.
Meditate on Marvelous Lovingkindness
Spend time meditating on this verse and let God’s lovingkindness fill your heart, strengthening your trust in Him in hard times.
Share Stories of Salvation
Tell family or friends how you have experienced God’s deliverance, and encourage them also to take refuge in God and see His marvelous lovingkindness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your marvelous lovingkindness, which stretches out a saving right hand just when we need it most. Help us to trust in You in times of difficulty and to share Your lovingkindness with more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s marvelous lovingkindness in every challenge, and live in gratitude and hope because of His deliverance. Amen!

v: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
b: This verse expresses the psalmist’s great thanks and praise for God’s lovingkindness, comparing it to the shelter of wings. Such love gives those who take refuge in Him a sense of safety and satisfaction. God’s lovingkindness is like a warm harbor: whatever storms we face, He is always at our side, giving us strength to meet the challenges of life.

It is like a little bird nestled under its mother’s wings, while the mother shields it from wind and rain and keeps it safe. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness shelters us from wind and rain, and His presence is our greatest peace and support.

There was a brother named Gao Zhenyu who went through a major upheaval at work and for a time lost his direction. In prayer he told God of his confusion and helplessness and asked for His guidance and comfort. Zhenyu later recalled that during his devotions he read this verse and felt the shelter of God’s lovingkindness. God let him understand that, however weak he was, he could still take refuge under the shadow of His wings and find peace. In the end, under God’s leading, he found a new direction, regained his confidence, and set new goals for his life.

Gao Zhenyu’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is the most precious support in our lives. When we feel weak, His wings shield us from the storm; when we feel confused, His lovingkindness shows us the way.

Dear family, let us remember how precious God’s lovingkindness is. He is our eternal refuge. Whatever challenges we face, we can take refuge fully under the shadow of His wings and receive comfort and strength from His lovingkindness.
a: A Time of Shelter
Each morning, take time to pour out your heart to God, feel the shelter of His lovingkindness, and seek His peace for the day’s challenges.
Sheltering Companionship
Care for those near you who need help, especially those facing difficulties, and become a temporary shelter for them, reflecting God’s lovingkindness.
Life Record
Write down a time when you felt God’s protection and share it with others, bearing witness to how precious God’s lovingkindness is.
Guarding with Lovingkindness
Show love and support to family and friends, becoming through your patience and care the shelter of wings in their lives.
Crossing Over in Faith
When facing a challenge, learn from Gao Zhenyu’s testimony: take refuge in God wholeheartedly and rely on His lovingkindness to find a breakthrough.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that Your lovingkindness is so precious and that we may take refuge under the shadow of Your wings. Be the shelter of our lives, give us peace and strength, and teach us to shelter those around us with love and support. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you enjoy peace in the shelter of God’s lovingkindness, and share this precious love with those around you. Amen!

v: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
b: Through the immeasurable distance between heaven and earth, this verse portrays how deep and wide God’s lovingkindness is toward those who fear Him. This love cannot be understood by human standards; it is full of boundless acceptance and grace, far beyond anything we can imagine. God’s lovingkindness does not depend on our conduct or performance, but is the outflow of His own nature.

It is like the starry sky of the universe. When we look up, we cannot see its end, yet we sense its vastness. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is boundless and always surrounds those who fear Him, giving us endless protection and support.

There was a brother named Li Wenjie who in his youth drifted from God under the pressures of life, until a serious health problem plunged him into deep loneliness and despair. He began to seek God again, praying with a reverent heart, and sensed that God’s lovingkindness had never left him. After his condition stabilized, he resolved to have devotions every day and to share God’s love with more people. He often says, “I have learned from God’s lovingkindness that His love has no limit. Even when we are weak or fail, He still receives us with limitless lovingkindness.”

Li Wenjie’s testimony tells us that, however difficult our situation, God’s lovingkindness is always as high as the heavens above the earth, surrounding those who fear Him and giving us boundless grace and support.

Dear family, let us remember how great God’s lovingkindness is. His love goes far beyond our understanding and expectation. Wherever we go, if we seek Him with a heart of reverence, we will find fulfillment and peace in His lovingkindness.
a: Look Up at the Stars
On a night when you can, look up at the starry sky, meditate on the greatness of God’s lovingkindness, and give thanks for His grace.
Testimonies of Lovingkindness
Recall times in your life when you experienced God’s lovingkindness and share these stories with family or friends at church, encouraging one another’s faith.
Build Reverence
In your daily devotions, meditate on God’s attributes, let your heart fill with reverence for Him, and live out that attitude of reverence.
Acts of Care
Show unconditional love and help to someone facing difficulty, and become a witness of God’s lovingkindness in their life.
Gratitude List
List the lovingkindness of God that you have experienced lately, and give these thanks to God in prayer.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your lovingkindness that is higher than the heavens, which gives us comfort and strength in difficulty and weakness. Teach us always to look up to Your grace, to respond to Your lovingkindness with reverence, and to pass this love on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s lovingkindness, higher than the heavens, in every day of your life, and share this love with those around you. Amen!

v: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips will praise you.
b: This verse reflects the psalmist’s deep experience of God’s lovingkindness. He considers it better and more precious than life itself. Life is important, but without God’s lovingkindness, life becomes meaningless. God’s lovingkindness is the core of our lives and the source of our joy and satisfaction, so our lips should be full of praise, expressing our thanks and worship to God.

It is like a person walking through a desert. What matters most is not the sand under his feet but a source of water, because water can save his life. In the same way, on life’s journey God’s lovingkindness is like living water, refreshing our souls and giving us strength and hope in hardship.

There was a sister named Li Xiuling who went through the darkest time of her life after being diagnosed with a serious illness. Facing the weakness of her body and the ordeal of treatment, she once felt despair. But in one prayer she deeply sensed God’s lovingkindness, and that unconditional love set her heart free and renewed her passion for life. She said, “Although my body is limited, God’s lovingkindness fills my spirit with freedom and peace, which is more precious than anything.” Later she shared her experience with other patients, bringing them hope and comfort.

Xiuling’s story reminds us that God’s lovingkindness not only carries us through life’s challenges but also gives us meaning and joy in living. When we understand that God’s love surpasses everything, our lips naturally break into praise for His wonderful works and grace.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is better than life, and this lovingkindness gives our lives hope and worth. May we praise His name with our lips every day and live out His love with grateful hearts.
a: Praise God Daily
Each morning, take three minutes to praise God with a thankful heart, listing the gracious gifts of His lovingkindness.
Words of Encouragement
Speak a word of comfort or encouragement to someone going through a low point, letting God’s lovingkindness flow out through you.
Sharing Love
Write down your story of experiencing God’s lovingkindness and share it with family or friends, to be a blessing to them.
A Gift of Thanks
Give a gift to someone who has helped you, expressing your thanks and passing on God’s lovingkindness.
Meditate on the Verse
Meditate on this verse every day, thinking about the wonder and richness of God’s lovingkindness, and pass this love on.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your lovingkindness that is better than life, which refreshes our souls and gives us peace and hope. Help us always to praise Your name, to respond to Your love with action, and to be a blessing in the lives of others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be satisfied with God’s lovingkindness every day, and live in peace and joy in His grace. Amen!

v: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.
b: This verse reveals the depth and endurance of God’s lovingkindness: His anger is only for a moment, but His love for us is everlasting. Even when we stray from the right path, God still calls us back with boundless love and restores our lives with His mercy. His lovingkindness is like a steady lighthouse that keeps guiding us through the storms of life, so that we can return to a safe harbor.

It is like a painter who may pause his work because of a flaw, but whose love keeps him from giving up, and who in the end carefully carves and polishes until a masterpiece is complete. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness does not end because of our weakness. He is always restoring and perfecting our lives, making us a masterpiece in His eyes.

There was a sister named Chen Xinyi who in her youth became estranged from her family after a conflict with someone, and even left the church. Many years later, on a trip alone, she read this verse in the Bible and was deeply moved. She realized that God’s love had never left her because of her mistakes, and that He was still waiting for her with lovingkindness to return to His embrace. Xinyi finally chose to take the first step to repair her relationship with her family and returned to serve in the church. She said, “God’s love taught me that true mercy can change a life.”
Xinyi’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is an irreplaceable strength in our lives. Even when a brief storm hides His brightness, His lovingkindness keeps on guarding us.
Dear family, let us remember that God has mercy on us with everlasting lovingkindness. Whatever we go through, His love is our harbor, helping us find a new beginning.
a: Lovingkindness Notebook
Keep a notebook and record each moment you sense God’s lovingkindness, such as when you were forgiven or when you experienced grace, and give thanks as you look back over it.
Tree of Grace
Make a “tree of grace” at home. On small cards, write down the events in which God has shown you His lovingkindness and hang them on the branches, letting the tree grow fuller over time.
Acts of Restoration
Take the first step to repair an estranged relationship by writing a letter or sending a message that expresses your heart and your forgiveness, putting God’s mercy into practice with love.
Good News Each Week
Each week, share with family or friends one piece of good news you experienced in God’s lovingkindness, and encourage one another’s faith.
Evening Prayer of Lovingkindness
Each evening, pray for three minutes, thanking God for His mercy and His constant presence, and entrust tomorrow’s difficulties to His lovingkindness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for having mercy on us with everlasting lovingkindness, so that we find comfort and hope in hardship. Help us to live out Your love and pass it on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you regain confidence in God’s lovingkindness and live a victorious life with a grateful heart. Amen!

v: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is an unchanging, eternal grace. His love transcends time and space and continually supplies our needs. His nature is good and His love is steadfast, so that wherever we are, we can find peace and hope. Such lovingkindness is the cornerstone of our lives and worthy of our praise and thanks every day.

God’s lovingkindness is like a gently flowing stream that never runs dry. In drought or in storm, it quietly waters our souls and brings renewal to our lives. This love not only soothes our wounds but also changes our lives, so that we too become channels of His love.

There was a brother named Lin Zisheng whose testimony vividly shows the eternal power of God’s lovingkindness. Zisheng had been a successful entrepreneur, but a sudden economic crisis cost him his company and his savings. He fell into deep despair, feeling he had lost everything. One day a friend came to visit him and reminded him in prayer that God’s love had never left. This led Zisheng to take a fresh look at his life. He remembered how God had held him up in hardship in the past, and he also saw his family’s unconditional support. Although everything outside seemed to be collapsing, God, through the love and support of his family, let Zisheng find strength for living again.

As time went by, he began to thank God for His lovingkindness and resolved to share his experience with more people who are struggling. Today he is an encourager, helping those going through hardship to see the light of God’s eternal lovingkindness.
Zisheng’s story reminds us that God’s lovingkindness does not appear only in good times. In the darkest hour, He is still with us, bringing us the power of restoration.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness endures forever, and His goodness and grace are shown in our lives at every moment. Whatever our situation, His love will be our hope and comfort.
a: Daily Reminders of Lovingkindness
Set a reminder on your phone three times a day, morning, noon, and evening, to remind yourself to thank God for His lovingkindness, with a simple prayer of thanks.
Thankfulness Box
Keep a box at home. Whenever you sense God’s lovingkindness, write a line of thanks and put it in the box, and share the contents with your family each week.
Lunchbox of Love
Prepare a lunchbox of love for someone in need, and bring God’s lovingkindness into another person’s life through practical action.
Lovingkindness Testimony Gathering
Hold a testimony-sharing gathering with your church or fellowship, inviting everyone to share stories of God’s lovingkindness, to encourage and build one another up.
Gratitude Journal Board
Make a board on which you write or draw, each day, the moments you sensed God’s lovingkindness, and put it where you will see it often, to remind yourself that God’s grace never stops.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your lovingkindness that endures forever. Whatever our situation, You always surround us with goodness and compassion. Teach us to respond to Your love with thankful hearts and to pass this love on to more people in need around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s unceasing lovingkindness every day, and live out His love with a thankful heart, bringing hope and joy to more people. Amen!

v: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
b: In poetic language, this verse portrays the vastness of God’s lovingkindness and the breadth of His faithfulness. God’s lovingkindness is like the boundless sky, with no end and never running dry, and His faithfulness is as firm and dependable as the heavens, giving us limitless security and support. Whatever our circumstances, God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness are at work in our lives, bringing change and hope.

It is like gazing at the starry sky: the starlight seems far away, yet it truly shines on us. In the same way, although God’s lovingkindness is higher than the heavens, it reaches into the depths of our hearts, upholds our every step, and lets us find heavenly peace in Him.

There was a sister named Zhou Xinran who had fallen into a long low period because of illness. In the days of bodily weakness she often felt lonely and helpless. But one early morning she saw the dawn on the horizon and instantly felt a warmth. At that moment she deeply sensed that God’s lovingkindness is like the morning light: however weary she was, God was still at her side, bringing her hope and strength. She began to count God’s graces in her hardship and to thank Him in prayer for His care. Gradually, although her body was not fully healed, her heart was filled with strength, and she began to encourage others who had similar experiences.

Xinran’s testimony reminds us that, whatever our circumstances, God’s lovingkindness is always higher and wider than our troubles, and His faithfulness never wavers, giving us eternal hope and support.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness are the greatest support in our lives. His love is as vast as the heavens and His faithfulness as firm as the skies. Let us respond to Him with thankful hearts and bring this love to more people in need.
a: Morning Prayer Time
Each morning, spend five minutes looking at the sky and praying, thanking God for His lovingkindness that reaches to the heavens, and seeking His guidance as the day begins.
Daily Journal
Record in words or pictures the moments of the day when you sensed God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness, and offer a prayer of thanks to God at night.
Stargazing Gathering
Look at the stars with family or friends and share testimonies of God’s faithfulness in your lives, encouraging one another’s faith.
Letters of Encouragement
Write a letter or send a message to a friend going through difficulty, encouraging them with the truth of Psalm 36:5 so that they can sense how dependable God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness are.
Acts of Love
Choose to help someone near you who needs support, whether by visiting, assisting, or caring for them, showing God’s lovingkindness through practical action.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your lovingkindness that reaches to the heavens and Your faithfulness that reaches to the skies, supplying our needs every moment and giving us peace and hope. We ask that You give us hearts that look to You alone, and that we live out Your love with thankfulness and be a blessing to others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense every day God’s lovingkindness that reaches to the heavens, and find peace and strength in His boundless faithfulness. Amen!

t: The Earth Is Full of Lovingkindness
v: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
b: This verse lets us see God’s character: He loves righteousness and justice, and His lovingkindness fills the whole earth. God’s love is not fragmentary or partial. Like sunshine, it shines over the whole earth, is present everywhere, and continually provides for each one of us. When we think about God’s lovingkindness, we find His love hidden in every detail of life. Whether a small blessing or a great grace, each shows His boundless love and faithfulness.

It is like spring rain falling on the fields, watering every plant and making the land teem with life. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness fills our lives and waters our souls, letting us grow and flourish and find peace in His love.

There was a sister named Lin Jiahui who, when she lost her job, fell into hardship and even began to doubt whether God still cared for her. But during that time a friend brought her food and daily necessities on her own initiative, and brothers and sisters from church prayed with her and gave her encouragement and support. Jiahui later understood that this care was exactly the concrete expression of God’s lovingkindness, and that He was passing His love to her through the people around her. In the end Jiahui not only found a new job but also came to feel more deeply how real and vast God’s lovingkindness is.

Jiahui’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness fills not only the whole earth but every day of our lives. We need only look with faith and gratitude to find the footprints of His love everywhere.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness, like spring rain, waters the earth and fills the whole earth, and fills our lives too. May we keep thankful hearts, share His lovingkindness with more people, and be messengers of His love.
a: Thankful Walk
Take a few minutes each day for a walk, noticing the beautiful things around you, seeing them as expressions of God’s lovingkindness, and thanking God for them.
Lovingkindness Cards
Write a thank-you card to someone who has helped you, expressing your gratitude and sharing the truth of God’s lovingkindness.
Share a Meal of Love
Prepare a meal for a friend or neighbor, passing on God’s love and care through action.
Little Surprises
Each day, prepare a small surprise for a family member or friend, so that they can sense your care and God’s love.
Prayerful Care
Choose someone in need, pray for them, and offer practical support on your own initiative, extending God’s lovingkindness into their life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for filling the whole earth with Your lovingkindness, which waters our lives everywhere. Help us to see Your grace with thankful hearts and to pass Your lovingkindness on to more people in love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see the imprint of God’s lovingkindness every day, and be filled with hope and joy in His love. Amen!

v: The earth, Yahweh, is full of your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
b: This verse shows us that God’s lovingkindness is everywhere, filling every corner of our lives. His statutes are like a guide of love, directing us to live out His heart in His abundant lovingkindness. When we watch for the traces of this lovingkindness, we find that God keeps showing His grace and goodness through nature and through the people and events of our lives.

It is like spring rain moistening parched soil and bringing everything back to life. God’s lovingkindness is like this rain, soaking into every level of our lives. As long as we hunger for His statutes, He will water our hearts with His word and give us heavenly vitality.

There was a sister named Zhao Yawen who felt lonely and helpless during the pandemic. One day she happened to walk into a park and saw an old woman carefully feeding a flock of birds. The scene made Yawen think of God’s care for her. Back home, she took up the habit of reading the Bible again and meditated on how God’s lovingkindness was showing itself in her life. She gradually understood that even in her loneliness, God’s lovingkindness was still revealing itself to her every morning and in the details of nature. This realization filled her with hope again and inspired her to reach out to those around her who needed help.
Yawen’s experience reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is around us at every moment. When we focus on His statutes, His lovingkindness becomes our strength for facing every challenge.

Dear family, let us keep in mind that God’s lovingkindness fills the earth. He guides us with His statutes and supports us with His grace. May we look to Him often in life, give thanks for all He gives, and answer His love with our lives.
a: Daily Record of Lovingkindness
Each day, write down three expressions of God’s lovingkindness that you have experienced, such as a blessing, a time of protection, or a word of encouragement.
A Journey of Worship in Nature
Arrange an outdoor walk or devotion, sense the display of God’s lovingkindness in nature, and offer Him your thanks.
Time to Meditate on His Statutes
Each day, choose a verse, meditate on it and apply it to your life, and see how God’s statutes guide you.
Lovingkindness Challenge
Take the initiative to reach out to someone in need, such as visiting a lonely neighbor or giving to a charitable ministry, and let God’s lovingkindness flow through your hands.
Family Worship Time
Share with your family how you have sensed God’s lovingkindness, read the Bible and pray together, and encourage one another to live out God’s heart.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for filling the earth with lovingkindness and for teaching us with Your statutes to walk in the path of light. Help us to see Your grace each day and to pass Your lovingkindness on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see the traces of God’s lovingkindness in every day of your life, and, guided by His statutes, live a life of joy and gratitude. Amen!

v: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
b: This verse beautifully portrays the harmony of God’s attributes: His lovingkindness and truth, His righteousness and peace, are interwoven in His kingdom. God has both compassionate lovingkindness and steadfast truth; He is both a righteous judge and a Savior who brings peace. This reminds us that, as God’s children, we should show such attributes in our lives: holding on to truth in lovingkindness, and bringing peace as we pursue righteousness.

It is like a bridge with lovingkindness and truth at one end, and righteousness and peace at the other. Only when both ends are secure can the whole bridge firmly carry those who cross. In the same way, our lives need a balance of these attributes in order to reflect God’s heart in our dealings with others.

There was a sister named Li Wenxuan who was an elementary school teacher. In one classroom dispute, two students quarreled endlessly over a misunderstanding. Wenxuan decided to mediate with lovingkindness and truth. She listened patiently to the children’s thoughts and expressed her care for them, and at the same time insisted on pointing out the truth, helping them see each other’s mistakes. In the end the children made up and learned how to treat others with love and honesty. Wenxuan’s approach not only solved the problem but also brought righteousness and peace into her classroom.
Wenxuan’s experience reminds us that when we practice lovingkindness and truth, righteousness and peace in our lives, our lives become a witness to God’s beautiful attributes.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness and truth, righteousness and peace, are the example we follow. May our lives show these attributes in every choice, and may we become vessels of God that bring harmony and blessing.
a: Honesty and Love Together
At home or at work, learn to speak the truth in love, expressing what is true while considering the other person’s feelings, so that relationships grow more harmonious.
Prayers for Righteousness and Peace
Each day, pray for the injustices in the world, asking God’s righteousness and peace to come upon the oppressed.
Combine Encouragement with Correction
When a child or friend makes a mistake, correct them with encouragement, letting love and truth exist together.
Peacemaker
Take the initiative to mediate conflicts in your life and help others find ways to reconcile, becoming a messenger of peace.
Daily Check of Attributes
Reflect on your words and actions of the day: have you held to truth in lovingkindness, and brought peace in righteousness? Pray to God for change where you fall short.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for filling our lives with lovingkindness and truth, righteousness and peace. Help us to learn Your attributes in everything, so that our words and actions reflect Your glory and we become vessels that make peace among people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold to truth in lovingkindness and bring peace in righteousness in your daily life, and witness to God’s grace and glory with your life. Amen!

v: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
b: This verse profoundly describes God’s attributes: His throne is founded on righteousness and justice, while lovingkindness and truth are the principles by which He acts. God’s rule is perfectly upright, and His love is full of sincerity, without falsehood. This reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is not a passing emotion but a steadfast, just love that brings us security and hope.

It is like a judge who is both fair and loving: he judges on the basis of fairness, yet he always treats the truly repentant with lovingkindness and grace. In the same way, our God is both a righteous King and a Father full of lovingkindness, and the way He acts always balances the two.

There was a brother named Gao Zhiyu who, after his business failed, fell into deep self-reproach and despair. He thought God would abandon him because of his failure, but as he sought God in prayer, he sensed that God was treating him with lovingkindness and truth. Zhiyu said, “God did not deny my wrong, but He used lovingkindness to encourage me to stand up, and used truth to teach me how to correct my mistakes.” He then re-examined the way he did business and started over on the principles of honesty and integrity. In the end he not only successfully rebuilt his business but also used his experience to help many others going through similar difficulties.
Zhiyu’s story reminds us that God’s lovingkindness and truth go before His face. He not only forgives our faults but also leads us by truth into the fullness of life.

Dear family, let us keep in mind that God’s throne is founded on righteousness and justice, and His lovingkindness and truth are at work in our lives at every moment. When we face challenges or failure, let us take refuge in Him, trusting that He will embrace us with lovingkindness and guide us with truth.
a: Honestly Examine Your Life
Spend a few minutes each day reflecting on whether your words and actions line up with God’s truth, note what needs correcting, and ask God in prayer for strength to change.
Plan for Acts of Lovingkindness
Take the initiative to care for someone in need, such as visiting the sick or helping a friend in trouble, and pass on God’s lovingkindness through action.
Learn the Principle of Fairness
At work and in life, pay special attention to whether your decisions are fair and upright, treating people and matters impartially, to the glory of God’s name.
Daily Honest Prayer
In prayer, be honest with God about your difficulties and failings, and ask for His truth to guide your path.
Testimony of Lovingkindness and Truth
Share a story of a time you experienced God’s lovingkindness or truthfulness, to encourage others to trust Him more.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for founding Your throne on righteousness and justice and guiding our lives with lovingkindness and truth. Help us always to live out Your truth, to treat others with lovingkindness and honesty, and to be vessels of Your good testimony. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense the presence of God’s lovingkindness and truth in every day of your life, and, led by His righteousness and justice, walk the bright path of life. Amen!

v: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
b: This verse reveals God’s promise to those who love Him and keep His word: His lovingkindness is not only a blessing for now but a grace handed down from generation to generation. God’s love is eternal, and He delights to pour out abundant lovingkindness on those who keep His commandments and fear Him. This reminds us that God’s love is the motivation for how we live, and that our obedience is the best way to respond to His love.

It is like a great tree whose roots go deep into rich soil, drawing nourishment from it so that its branches flourish and bear much fruit. God’s lovingkindness is that rich soil. When our lives are deeply rooted in His truth, we can bear spiritual fruit and pass this blessing on to the next generation.

There was a brother named Li Jianming whose family had believed in the Lord for generations. His father taught him to read the Bible and pray every day and to treat others with honesty and love. Jianming held to these principles in the workplace. Although he sometimes faced temptations to cut corners or compromise, he chose to keep God’s word and be a person of integrity. Years later, his children also learned from him the firmness and love of this faith, and likewise lived lives that belong to God. Jianming said with emotion, “When I see my children growing in God’s grace as well, I understand even more the truth that God shows lovingkindness to a thousand generations.”
Jianming’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness does not stop with an individual life but, through our faith and actions, can become a blessing handed down from generation to generation.

Dear family, let us remember that God shows lovingkindness to thousands of those who love Him and keep His commandments. Let our lives take root in His lovingkindness and pass this love on to more people.
a: Daily Time of Worship
Set aside a fixed time each day to read the Bible and pray, deeply experiencing God’s commandments and lovingkindness, and letting your spiritual life take root in His truth.
Passing On Faith in the Family
Share God’s word with your children or family, hold family worship times, and pass God’s lovingkindness down through the generations.
Journal of Thanks for Lovingkindness
Record the ways God has shown lovingkindness in your life, thank Him for His grace, and use this to remind yourself to love Him and obey Him.
Acts of Love
Respond to God’s lovingkindness with practical action, such as visiting families in need or giving to groups that serve the vulnerable, becoming a continuation of His lovingkindness.
Pass On a Spiritual Blessing
Write a letter or send a message to someone near you, sharing God’s lovingkindness and encouraging them also to love God and keep His commandments.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing lovingkindness to thousands of those who love You and keep Your commandments. Help us to live out Your word in daily life and to show Your love through our actions. May Your lovingkindness be passed on through us to more people, so that we become light and salt in the world. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
