dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive His boundless lovingkindness because you love God, and may you use this love to influence the people around you and your descendants, and live a heavenly life. Amen!

t: Great Is the Lovingkindness You Show Me
v: For great is your loving kindness toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is not only a warm feeling but a powerful act of rescue. When we fall into trouble or face the lows of life, God’s lovingkindness becomes our greatest support and protection. He not only redeems our souls but also leads us out of darkness and into His kingdom of light.

It is like a sea rescuer who, in the most critical moment, jumps without hesitation into the raging waves to save a life in danger. God’s lovingkindness is like this too: in our deepest helplessness and darkness, He stretches out His mighty hand and brings us back into the light of peace and hope.

There was a brother named Chen Zhiyong who fell into financial trouble after a wrong decision and carried a huge debt. He felt utterly hopeless and at one point even considered giving up his life. But in his darkest hour he remembered God’s lovingkindness and salvation. He knelt and asked God for help, begging Him to lead him out of his predicament. Afterward he worked hard to find new job opportunities and sincerely sought support from his family and friends. A few years later he had not only paid off all his debts but had also found a new direction in his career. He said, “God’s lovingkindness saved my soul and let me know that, however much I fail, He will never give up on me.”
Zhiyong’s story tells us that God’s lovingkindness is a powerful saving force that not only rescues our souls but also gives us new hope and direction in difficulty.
Dear family, let us remember that the lovingkindness God shows us is great. He delights to save us, and no matter how deep a low we are in, His love can pull us back onto the path of light.
a: Seeing Light in the Dark
Look back on difficulties you have gone through, list how God rescued you with His lovingkindness, and record them with a thankful heart.
Share a Testimony
Share with your group or the brothers and sisters at church the wonderful deliverance God has given in your life, encouraging them to believe in His lovingkindness and power.
Support Those in Trouble
Take the initiative to care for someone going through hardship, pray for them, and help them see God’s lovingkindness through practical action.
Daily Prayer of Thanks
Each day, spend five minutes thanking God for His lovingkindness, especially for the times He helped you, drawing your heart closer to Him.
Plan for Revival of Love
Start an “act of lovingkindness,” whether giving, volunteering, or a simple visit, passing God’s great love on to those in need.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing us Your great lovingkindness, for rescuing us from darkness and bringing us into Your light and peace. Help us always to remember Your grace and to influence others with this love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s great lovingkindness in the challenges of every day, and, because of His salvation, walk into a future full of hope. Amen!

v: Know therefore that Yahweh your God, he is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments;
b: This verse reminds us that God is a faithful God. He not only keeps His covenant but also bestows lovingkindness on those who love Him and keep His commandments, and this lovingkindness continues to a thousand generations. God’s lovingkindness is not only a blessing in our lives but also a precious promise, showing His lasting faithfulness and love toward His people.

It is like a master architect who, with patience and focus, designs sturdy houses for every generation to protect them from wind and rain. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is a secure shelter that gives lasting protection and blessing to those who love Him and keep His word.

There was a brother named Li Zhiming whose family has trusted in God for three generations. His grandfather held to honesty in times of financial hardship and raised his family by faith in God. Zhiming’s father kept to his grandfather’s faith and values, remaining upright and doing good in his career. Zhiming says the most important lesson he learned in his family is this: God’s lovingkindness has never left their home. When he meets challenges, he can always recall his forefathers’ experiences and trust that God will lead him through with the same lovingkindness and faithfulness.

Zhiming’s testimony tells us that God’s lovingkindness is not only a blessing for an individual life but a spiritual inheritance that can be handed down, influencing our descendants and those around us.

Dear family, let us remember that the lovingkindness God bestows on us is lasting and faithful. When we love Him and keep His commandments, our lives will not only be blessed but will also become a blessing in the lives of others.
a: Family Time of Thanks
Look back together with your family on God’s lovingkindness, share how He has blessed your lives, and pray for future generations.
Day of Meditating on a Commandment
Choose one of God’s commandments, think about how to practice it concretely in daily life, and write down your plan.
Pass On Stories of Lovingkindness
Record in writing or video the testimonies of God’s lovingkindness in your family, and share them with relatives and friends or with your descendants.
Record of Grace
Make a “list of God’s lovingkindness,” writing down at least three things each day in which you see God’s grace, to remind yourself of His faithfulness.
A Gift of Faith Heritage
Prepare a spiritual journal for your children or the next generation, recording your experience of God’s faithfulness and lovingkindness as an encouragement to their faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being a faithful God who bestows lovingkindness to a thousand generations on those who love You and keep Your commandments. Help us to respond to Your love with action and to pass this love on to our descendants and those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. As you keep God’s word, may you often experience His lovingkindness that lasts for a thousand generations, and pass this love on to future generations. Amen!

v: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness and truth are the safeguard He has prepared for our lives. When we entrust our lives to Him, His lovingkindness becomes our shelter and His truth becomes our guide, so that we may pass each day securely in His presence. This is a promise from God, so that we find comfort not only in hardship but also experience His grace in good times.

It is like a ship under sail: God’s lovingkindness is the warm sea breeze driving us forward, and His truth is the steady course that keeps us from straying off the right path. When storms come, we know He has already prepared protecting strength for us.

There was a brother named Chen Zhikai who faced a major business crisis when a partner’s betrayal plunged the company into financial trouble. His heart was full of confusion and helplessness, and he began to reflect on whether his decisions were in line with God’s will. In prayer he sensed that God’s lovingkindness and truth were his greatest support. Zhikai decided to put down his anger and unease and to face the challenge with honesty and love. He took the initiative to communicate with clients and openly shared the company’s situation with his employees. Wonderfully, in the course of this God prepared new partnership opportunities for him, and in the end his company was revived. Zhikai came to understand deeply that God’s lovingkindness and truth were indeed the firmest safeguard in his life.
Zhikai’s experience tells us that when we are willing to rely on God’s lovingkindness and truth, we can see His protection in hardship and experience His abundant grace at every stage of life.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness and truth have been prepared for us, and His protection is never absent. Whatever challenges we face, we can entrust our lives securely into His hands.
a: Map of Grace
Make a “map of God’s grace,” recording times in the past when you experienced God’s protection and marking the traces of His grace with illustrations.
Letter of Faith
Write a letter to yourself, thanking God for His lovingkindness and truth in hard times, and reminding yourself to keep trusting Him in future challenges.
Day of Honesty
Choose a day to pay special attention to facing every person, matter, circumstance, and problem with honesty and lovingkindness, letting your life witness to God’s character.
Acts of Protection
Take the initiative to protect and help someone in need, such as a friend or family member in trouble, so that they sense God’s lovingkindness revealed through your actions.
Family Time of Lovingkindness
Share with your family each person’s testimony of how they have experienced God’s lovingkindness, truth, and protection in the past, encouraging one another and strengthening faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the lovingkindness and truth You have prepared for our lives, so that we can receive protection and guidance in Your presence. Help us to see Your grace in our daily lives and to answer Your great love with lovingkindness and truth. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s protecting lovingkindness and the guidance of His truth every day, and live a secure and abundant life in His presence. Amen!

v: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
b: This verse reveals God’s eternal, unchanging love for His people and the firmness of His covenant faithfulness. God’s lovingkindness is not temporary, and it does not change because of people’s failures; His covenant is as firm as a rock. This lets us know that, whatever we go through, God’s lovingkindness is kept unchanged and His promises remain the same, bringing comfort and hope to our lives.

It is like a century-old tree that stands unfallen through frost, wind, rain, and snow, still giving shelter among its branches to living creatures. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is as solid as that old tree, always sheltering us from wind and rain. Even if we occasionally stray from His path, His love is still kept for us, waiting for us to return.

There was a brother named Wu Jianhua who in his youth drifted from the faith in pursuit of fame and gain, and even doubted God’s existence. But after a major setback in his career, he cried out to God in helplessness, and his heart was gradually touched by God’s word. Jianhua returned to church and experienced God’s unconditional lovingkindness at the gatherings. He shared, “Even though I was away from God for so long, His lovingkindness was kept for me all along. This made me understand that God’s promises never change, and that His love was always waiting for me.” Today Jianhua serves God with firmer faith and continually experiences the richness of His grace in his life.

Jianhua’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness has never left us and His promises are always reliable. Even if we are weak or lost, as long as we return to Him, He receives us with His unchanging love.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness never changes and His covenant is always firm. At any time, by this lovingkindness we can be strengthened anew and live a life that glorifies Him.
a: Gratitude Journal
Each day, record the traces of God keeping His lovingkindness in your life, sensing His unchanging love in small things.
Review the Journey of Faith
Quiet your heart and recall your journey of faith, write down a time when you especially experienced God’s lovingkindness, and share it with family or friends.
Reminder of Promises
Set a reminder on your phone or calendar to keep God’s unchanging promises in mind, and encourage yourself with Scripture.
Plan to Pass On Lovingkindness
Choose someone you think needs encouragement, show care for them, and pass God’s lovingkindness on to them.
Sharing a Testimony of Faith
Take the initiative to share in a small group or at church your experience of God’s lovingkindness and promises, encouraging other brothers and sisters to trust in God’s faithfulness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for keeping eternal lovingkindness for us and guarding our lives with firm promises. Help us always to remember Your grace and to answer Your love with thankfulness and trust. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s unchanging lovingkindness every day, and find peace and hope in His firm promises. Amen!

v: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is constant and unchanging, and that His righteousness goes hand in hand with His lovingkindness. God especially watches over those who know Him and love Him, and deals righteously with the upright in heart. This lovingkindness is continual; it does not change because of people’s failures or weaknesses, but, founded on grace, it satisfies those who put their trust in Him.

It is like a lighthouse that never goes out, showing the way to ships that have lost their course. However fierce the storm, the lighthouse keeps shining steadily. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is not shaken by circumstances or by our failures, and His righteousness, like that firm foundation, always guides us along the bright path.

There was a brother named Li Jianguo who, at a low point in his life, deeply experienced God’s continual lovingkindness. His business had failed, and his family was strained under financial pressure. One Sunday he summoned up the courage to return to church and joined a prayer meeting. In prayer he felt God’s lovingkindness seep into his heart like a warm current. He gradually understood that God’s lovingkindness had never left, and that he only needed to turn to Him and trust His guidance. From then on Jianguo began to rely firmly on God and faced his challenges again in faith. His family relationships slowly recovered, and his business gradually picked up. Jianguo later shared, “Even in the darkest moment of my life, God’s lovingkindness still surrounded me and gave me strength to stand up again.”
Jianguo’s experience reminds us that, whatever our circumstances, as long as we know God and trust Him, His lovingkindness will continually water our lives and open the way for us in righteousness.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness endures and that He leads every upright heart in righteousness. Whatever challenges we face, we can receive His abundant grace and lovingkindness through faith.
a: Sticky Notes of Lovingkindness
Each day, write down an encouraging verse and stick it on your mirror or desk, reminding yourself that God’s lovingkindness continues.
Plan for Upright Action
Pick one upright thing that you find difficult but should do, boldly do it, and give the glory to God.
A Time of Care
Take the initiative to visit or contact someone going through difficulty, passing God’s lovingkindness and comfort on to them.
Time to Share Thanks
Each day, share with family or friends one thing in which you experienced God’s lovingkindness, and encourage them to record their own moments of thanks.
Do Good in Righteousness
Choose to support a righteous social ministry or charitable organization and take part, showing God’s love and righteousness through action.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for continually showing lovingkindness and guiding us in righteousness. Help us to live uprightly in daily life, to be witnesses of Your love, and to pass Your lovingkindness on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s continual lovingkindness every day, and walk the path of uprightness because of His righteousness. Amen!

v: You gave me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
b: This verse is part of Job’s prayer in the midst of his trials, expressing his thanks and praise to God. Even in suffering, Job acknowledges that God is the Lord who gave him life and lovingkindness and who continues to visit and preserve his spirit. This reminds us that, whatever our circumstances, God’s gift of life and His lovingkindness are always beside us and have never left.

It is like a gardener who, whatever the wind and rain, still tends his garden carefully every day to make sure every plant grows strong. In the same way, God nourishes our lives with His lovingkindness and preserves our spirits with His care, so that even in difficulty we can stand firm by His grace.

There was a brother named Lin Zhiming who was seriously injured in an accident. Not only did he suffer great physical pain, but his work was interrupted, which put his family in difficulty. During his long recovery he began to pray more and poured out his helplessness and fear to God. One day, in his devotions, he suddenly felt a warm peace, as though God Himself were saying to him, “The life and lovingkindness I have given you are enough to carry you through all this.” From that day he no longer despaired but faced rehabilitation and life’s challenges with confidence. In the end, he not only recovered physically but also found a more stable job. He often says, “It was God’s lovingkindness that gave me the strength of life and also preserved my spirit.”
Zhiming’s testimony reminds us that God’s gift of life and lovingkindness are not only a blessing but also a strength that lets us find hope and direction in any difficulty.

Dear family, let us remember that God not only gave us life but also continues to nourish and preserve our spirits with His lovingkindness. In any situation, by this lovingkindness we can walk calmly through every stretch of life’s journey.
a: Thank-You Card for the Grace of Life
Write a thank-you card listing specific experiences in which you have felt God’s gift of life and lovingkindness, and offer your thanks to God.
Daily Care of the Soul
Set aside a quiet time to focus on prayer and meditation, and sense God’s care that preserves your spirit.
Share Your Life Story
Share with family or friends a story of how you experienced God’s lovingkindness in difficulty, and encourage them also to trust God.
Plan for Nourishing Life
Each week, choose a devotional book or a passage of Scripture to strengthen the health of your soul and let God’s word nourish your heart.
Encouragement and Care
Take the initiative to contact a friend or fellow believer going through difficulty, pray for them, and comfort their soul with God’s lovingkindness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us life and lovingkindness, and for preserving our spirits with Your continual care. Let us often sense Your presence and answer Your grace with thankful hearts. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s grace of life and the protection of His lovingkindness every day, and live a good life with a heart full of trust and thanks. Amen!

v: In your loving kindness, you have led the people who you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
b: This verse records the song of praise the Israelites sang after crossing the Red Sea, a deep thanksgiving for God’s redeeming power and lovingkindness. God saved His people by His lovingkindness and led them out of bondage in Egypt into the promised land. In the same way, today we too can be set free by God’s lovingkindness and, under His leading, enter a land of spiritual abundance.

It is like a pilot who, on a sea of high winds and waves, uses the light of a lighthouse to guide a ship safely into harbor. God’s lovingkindness is the lighthouse on our life’s voyage, and His power is our sail, guiding us in difficulty so that we do not stray from the course and finally reach the place of spiritual rest.

There was a sister named Li Peiling who had almost lost hope for her family because of conflicts within it. But at a retreat she sensed God’s lovingkindness at work in her life, and that He was willing to heal her heart and was able to mend broken relationships. Peiling began to commit it to God in prayer and to communicate with her family in love. Although there were struggles along the way, she believed deeply that God’s lovingkindness would lead her toward restoration and reconciliation. A few years later she witnessed the rebuilding of her family relationships, and the journey made her faith firmer.

Peiling’s experience reminds us that God’s lovingkindness not only saves us out of difficulty but also leads us toward His abundance and holiness. When we follow His leading closely, He will lead our lives with lovingkindness and power into the good land He has prepared for us.
Dear family, let us remember that God, in His lovingkindness and power, not only redeems us but continues to lead us on His path. Whatever lies ahead, His presence is our greatest assurance.
a: Daily Meditation on His Leading
Each morning, meditate on how God has led you through hard times in the past, and commit the day’s journey into His hands.
Lovingkindness Journal
Record every small testimony of God’s lovingkindness leading you, and review them at the end of each month, giving thanks for God’s work.
Plan for Spiritual Milestones
Set a spiritual goal, whether Bible reading, prayer, or service, and ask God to guide you to complete it by His lovingkindness.
Acts of Restoring Relationships
Take the initiative to contact someone with whom you want to reconcile or be closer, and witness to God’s lovingkindness through love and communication.
Share God’s Leading with Others
Tell a friend or family member the story of how God has led you with lovingkindness, and encourage them also to trust in God’s leading.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for redeeming us in lovingkindness and leading us in Your way by Your power. In our daily lives, let us rely on Your lovingkindness and power, step forward with courage, and enter the abundant land of promise You have prepared for us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you face every step of life with courage under the leading of God’s lovingkindness, and by His power reach the land of promise He has prepared for you. Amen!

v: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember to me this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.
b: This verse is Nehemiah’s prayer to God, in which he longs for God to remember him for his faithfulness and to have mercy on him according to God’s great lovingkindness. In the course of leading the people of Israel to rebuild the holy city and restore worship, Nehemiah understood that only God’s lovingkindness and mercy could accomplish everything. He also knew that obeying God’s law and keeping holiness is the way to receive God’s favor.

It is like a faithful gardener who not only plants diligently but also tends carefully, expecting the plants in the garden to bear good fruit. Every step the gardener takes is in response to the master who gave him the land. In the same way, every good thing we do is a response to God’s great lovingkindness, and we hope that He will remember our faithfulness.

There was a sister named Chen Zihan who kept facing injustice and pressure at work, but she always chose to act with integrity and honesty. Although she sometimes felt discouraged along the way, she prayed every day, committed her efforts to God, and asked Him to remember her labor according to His great lovingkindness. A few years later, Zihan’s honesty and diligence were recognized by her supervisor, and she was promoted to a higher position and so had more influence to witness for God.

Zihan’s testimony tells us that when we walk faithfully in God’s will, He will remember our labor and have mercy on us according to His great lovingkindness. Even in times that seem difficult, God’s lovingkindness is our greatest support and strength.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s great lovingkindness is the endless grace and assurance of our lives. When we faithfully do His will, He will show His mercy and blessing in our lives.
a: Plan for Examining Faithfulness
Before the day ends, spend five minutes reviewing today’s actions, examine whether you have faithfully done God’s will, and commit unfinished matters to Him in prayer.
Respond to Lovingkindness with Good Deeds
Choose a small good deed that helps others, whether supporting a friend or assisting a coworker, and offer your good deed to God as a response to His lovingkindness.
Notebook of Remembrance and Thanks
Keep a notebook to record the lovingkindness and mercy of God you experienced today, and in thanksgiving ask God to lead your next step.
Practice Faithfulness at Work
Keep your integrity and diligence at work, whether or not anyone sees, and regard your effort as service offered to God.
Family Sharing Time
Share with your family the story of how you sensed God’s lovingkindness today, and pray for one another’s needs, making your family a place that witnesses to lovingkindness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for having mercy on us in Your great lovingkindness and for remembering every faithful thing we have done. Guide us to act in Your lovingkindness each day, and to answer Your grace with faithful hearts. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you act every day in God’s great lovingkindness, serve Him faithfully, and find fulfillment and comfort in His grace. Amen!

v: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul. Save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
b: This verse shows the psalmist’s longing and plea in the midst of trouble. He knows his own strength is limited, but he firmly believes that God’s lovingkindness can bring reversal and redemption. God’s lovingkindness is not only what we lean on but also the source from which we regain strength. When we are weak, He stretches out a saving hand; when we are lost, He sends down a guiding light.

It is like a campfire in winter: when the cold surrounds people, the warmth of the fire lets them feel the strength of life again. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is our comfort when our souls are cold, helping us pick ourselves up and walk toward a bright future.

There was a sister named Xu Yahan who had been discouraged by long-term unemployment and even began to doubt her own worth. By chance she took part in a devotional event at church, where people prayed and mentioned that God’s lovingkindness is unconditional, which led her to re-examine her faith. Yahan began to quiet herself each day to pray to God, asking His lovingkindness to fill her heart. A few weeks later she not only found a new job but also found, in the new environment, a group of friends who supported one another. Yahan said, “God’s lovingkindness is like a campfire in the dead of winter. It not only drove away my fear but also let my heart feel warmth and hope again.”

Yahan’s story reminds us that, however difficult our situation, God’s lovingkindness is our source of strength. When we are willing to call on Him, His lovingkindness will open a new path for us and bring unexpected blessings.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is an assurance that never fades. Whatever challenges we face, He longs to embrace and help us with His love.
a: Campfire Thanksgiving Gathering
Sit together with family or friends and share stories of experiencing God’s lovingkindness, and offer thanks for His grace.
Acts of Warmth
Prepare a thoughtful little gift, such as a scarf or a hot drink, for someone near you who is going through difficulty, so that they feel love and warmth.
Daily Meditation on Lovingkindness
Each morning, meditate on a passage of Scripture, reflect on how God has saved you in lovingkindness, and give Him thanks for these things.
Cards of Loving Encouragement
Write a card of encouragement to a friend facing a challenge, using your words to remind them that God’s lovingkindness never leaves.
Pray and Pass It On
Each day, call on God’s lovingkindness for yourself and others, and share your testimonies of victorious faith with more people, letting lovingkindness become a force that touches others.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that Your lovingkindness warms our hearts like a campfire and gives us strength to face difficulty. Help us to become vessels of Your lovingkindness and to pass Your warmth on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find strength in God’s lovingkindness every day, and, because of His salvation, live a life full of hope and gratitude. Amen!

v: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore with loving kindness have I drawn you.
b: This verse lets us see God’s deep love for His people, a love that is eternal and unchanging and that draws us to Him with lovingkindness. His lovingkindness is not offered in exchange for conditions; He unconditionally shows us His mercy and grace and brings us back to His embrace. In the confusion and falls of life, it is His lovingkindness that wakes us up and lets us find the direction of life again.

It is like the tides of the sea, which push water toward the shore without ceasing day and night, drawing people near to its calm and grandeur. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is like these tides: however far we have gone, His love always calls us home with gentle strength.

There was a sister named Zhou Jiaen who drifted from the faith in her teens out of rebellion. Many years later, her family was injured and hospitalized in an accident, and she felt utterly helpless. In the hospital prayer room Jiaen knelt and asked for God’s help, and a verse she had heard in childhood came to her mind: “I have loved you with an everlasting love.” She sensed deeply that God’s lovingkindness was still calling her. At that moment she resolved to return to God and begin a life of reliance on Him. Her life was turned around by God’s lovingkindness, and today she is an enthusiastic servant in the church, helping many young people find their way home.

Jiaen’s story reminds us that, however lost we have been, God’s lovingkindness has never changed. He draws us with eternal love, giving us the chance to return to His embrace and enjoy His blessing and comfort.

Dear family, let us remember that God loves us with an everlasting love and draws us back into His presence with lovingkindness. However far our lives have gone, as long as we are willing to respond to His love, His arms are always open to receive us.
a: Reconnect with God
Set aside a day for quiet meditation, review how God has drawn you with lovingkindness, and pour out your thanks to Him.
Acts of Loving Embrace
Take the initiative to hug the people you love, letting them feel the power of love and telling them how important they are.
Letters of Lovingkindness
Write a thank-you letter to those who have helped you with love, thanking them for their love and company.
Acts of Acceptance
Reach out an accepting hand to those who once drifted from you but whom you hope to reconcile with, and learn to draw them with God’s love.
Create Moments of Love
Share a passage of Scripture or a story with family or friends, sensing and passing on God’s lovingkindness, and drawing closer to one another.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for loving us with an everlasting love and drawing us back to Your presence with lovingkindness. Help us to become vessels of love and to share Your lovingkindness with more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense every day the power of God drawing you with lovingkindness, and find true peace and fulfillment in His eternal love. Amen!

v: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
b: This verse lets us see that God is not only the Lord of lovingkindness but also our refuge and the one who carries out justice. He meets us with lovingkindness, so that in life’s troubles we receive comfort and protection. At the same time, His justice lets us trust that whatever hostility and challenges we face, He will be our helper and in the end bring victory.

It is like a safe harbor: when the storm rages, ships can come to shore to rest, resupply, and be repaired. In our lives, God is that harbor who meets us with lovingkindness. He receives us with warm hands and protects us with His power from the harm of our enemies.

There was a brother named Huang Zhiwen who had been treated unfairly at work. His supervisor falsely accused him, leaving him to bear blame he did not deserve. In those hard days Zhiwen prayed to God every day, seeking His help. He was convinced that God would meet him with lovingkindness and give him a just answer. A few months later the truth came out, the person who had falsely accused him was exposed, Zhiwen’s innocence was proven, and his integrity won the company’s respect. He said gratefully, “In those hard days it was God’s lovingkindness that sustained me, so that I did not give up hope and finally saw His justice revealed.”
Zhiwen’s experience reminds us that when we feel trapped or attacked, we should not lose faith, because God’s lovingkindness will meet us and His justice will surely bring the best outcome.
Dear family, let us remember that, whatever challenges we face, God’s lovingkindness is always ahead of us, meeting us. His protection and justice are the firmest support in our lives.
a: Write Down God’s Welcome
In your devotional notebook, record a time you sensed God meeting you with lovingkindness, and share it with family or friends to encourage one another.
Make a Thank-You Card
Write a thank-you card to someone who helped you in your difficulty, letting them sense that God’s love flows through you.
Acts of Faithful Prayer
Pray for those who have been falsely accused or treated unjustly, asking God’s lovingkindness to meet them and His justice to be revealed.
Build a Harbor
Take part in church or community activities and become a support system for others, passing on God’s lovingkindness and protection through practical action.
A Loving Embrace
Take the initiative to care for those near you who feel weary or hurt, giving a hug or an encouraging word so that they feel accepted and cared for.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for meeting us with lovingkindness, for giving us strength in difficulty and vindicating us when we are attacked. Help us to be channels of Your lovingkindness, bringing this love to more people so that they too can see Your justice and grace. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience, every day, the warmth of God meeting you with lovingkindness, and find firm faith and hope in His justice. Amen!

v: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
b: This verse lets us see the psalmist’s repentant heart and his deep dependence on God’s lovingkindness. God is not only a God who judges sin but a Father full of lovingkindness, who is willing to replace our transgressions with favor and mercy. In God’s lovingkindness we can find forgiveness and renewal, a hope that brings great reassurance.

It is like an old craftsman restoring a damaged painting. He does not fix his attention on the cracks in the painting but restores its original appearance with patience and skill. God is the same: what He values is the potential in our lives, not our past. He reshapes us with lovingkindness, making us into the pattern He has in His heart.

There was a brother named Chen Guanlin who in his youth did many things out of rebellion that disappointed his parents, and for a time drifted away from the faith. But at the lowest point of his life God’s word deeply touched him, brought him to see his transgressions, and led him to repent before God. He said, “When I thought God would reject me, He received me with lovingkindness and gave me a new direction.” Guanlin is now a church worker, and he uses his story to help young people and lead them into experiencing God’s forgiveness and lovingkindness.

Guanlin’s testimony tells us that God will not give up on us because of our past. As long as we are willing to repent, His lovingkindness is always beside us, turning our lives into a testimony to His glory.

Dear family, let us remember that God remembers us according to His lovingkindness, and His favor far exceeds our transgressions. Whatever our past, when we return to Him we can find new life and hope.
a: Repentance Journal
Each day, spend time reflecting on your conduct, record what you need to repent of before God, and bring them to Him in prayer and commit them to Him.
Restored Painting
Make a painting or a puzzle that symbolizes how God mends our lives with lovingkindness, expressing your gratitude creatively.
Testimony of Favor
Share with friends or family a story of experiencing God’s lovingkindness through repentance, and encourage them also to come before God.
Prayer Connection
Form a prayer group to intercede for one another and pray for those who need to repent and seek God’s favor, bearing witness to His forgiveness and love.
List of Forgiveness
List the people you need to forgive, commit them to God, follow His example of lovingkindness, and learn to let go of resentment.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for remembering us according to Your lovingkindness, forgiving our transgressions, and renewing our lives with Your favor. Help us to experience Your lovingkindness in repentance every day and to make our lives a testimony of Your love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive forgiveness and renewal in God’s lovingkindness every day, and glorify His name with a new life. Amen!

v: Rise up for our help. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
b: This verse is the psalmist’s heartfelt cry to God, expressing firm trust in God’s lovingkindness. When we face difficulty and pressure, can we hold this kind of faith and ask God for His help and redemption? God’s lovingkindness is the foundation of our salvation, and He is willing to stretch out a hand and rescue us from our predicament.

It is like a lifeguard who is always watching the people in the water, and when someone cries out for rescue, he jumps in without hesitation and pulls them out. In the same way, God, in His lovingkindness, saves us when we are helpless, lets us stand again, and gives us hope for the future.

There was a brother named Lin Yaozhong whose life once fell into great turmoil. He experienced business failure and strained family relationships, and was crushed by a deep sense of defeat. One day he knelt on the ground and cried out to God, “Lord, I cannot change my situation by myself. Redeem me in Your lovingkindness!” As he persisted in prayer and Bible reading every day, he gradually sensed God’s grace coming upon him, and the burden in his heart began to lighten. He said, “Only when I entrusted everything to God did I truly experience His lovingkindness, which brought me out of my predicament and gave me back my direction in life.”

Yaozhong’s testimony reminds us that, whatever challenges we face, God’s lovingkindness is always our support. When we choose to call on Him and trust in His redemption, His grace will come and change our circumstances and our hearts.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the greatest assurance in our lives. He is willing to redeem us in His lovingkindness, lead us through every low point, and bring us into the abundant life He has prepared for us.
a: Day of Crying Out in Prayer
Set a fixed time each day to cry out to God specifically about the difficulty or need you face now, learning to depend wholly on His redemption.
Write a List of Hope
List the things that make you feel helpless right now, and next to each write one of God’s promises, to remind yourself that His lovingkindness is always reliable.
Help the Helpless
Look for people near you who need help, and use your actions to become a channel of God’s lovingkindness, passing on His redeeming love.
Share a Testimony of Grace
Share with your family or friends how you have experienced God’s lovingkindness and help, and inspire them also to learn to trust Him.
Time of Thankful Worship
Each day, worship God with a hymn, thanking Him for His lovingkindness and laying your burdens at His feet.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for redeeming us in lovingkindness, bringing us out of difficulty, and giving us new hope. Help us to learn to rely on You in hardship and to be witnesses to Your lovingkindness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often experience God’s lovingkindness, help, and redemption in difficulty, and glorify His name with a life full of hope. Amen!

v: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
b: This verse is the psalmist’s heartfelt plea to God, as he longs for God’s promise to become a source of comfort. God’s lovingkindness is not only an endless supply but also a power in the spirit that helps us find solace in sorrow and trouble. When we rely on God’s word, His lovingkindness becomes warmth that fills what is lacking in our hearts.

It is like a cup of warm tea in the dead of winter, which not only drives away the cold but also brings a feeling of comfort. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness can be like this tea, refreshing our souls and helping us find comfort and support in the valley.

There was a sister named Chen Yating who, after losing a loved one, felt great pain and emptiness. In those days she often wept and felt unable to go on. But she began to read the Bible and pray every day, especially meditating on the lovingkindness mentioned in God’s promises. Once, when she read this verse, she sensed deeply God’s lovingkindness flowing into her heart like a warm current. Yating said, “I know God did not let my pain be in vain. He comforted me with His promises and let me feel that He had been with me all along, leading me by the hand through those dark days.”

Yating’s story tells us that God’s lovingkindness can become the comfort of our souls in our most difficult moments. As long as we hold tightly to His promises, we can find the strength to stand again in His word.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is real and within reach. When we are willing to open our hearts to Him, He will surely soothe our wounds with His endless lovingkindness and bring us comfort and strength.
a: Treasure Box of Promises
Prepare a box and write in it the promises in the Bible about God’s lovingkindness. When you feel weary, draw one out to meditate on.
A Visit of Comfort
Take the initiative to visit someone who is going through difficulty, bringing a passage of Scripture and a prayer as an encouragement, and be a channel of God’s lovingkindness.
Comfort Diary
Each day, record one way God comforted you with His lovingkindness, so that your thanks accumulate into a testimony of faith.
Meditation on Promises
Each day, choose a verse about God’s lovingkindness, memorize it, and apply it to your present life, sensing His presence.
Pass On Hope
Prepare a simple gift or a letter for someone near you who needs help, and bring God’s lovingkindness and comfort through your actions.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for comforting us with the promises of Your lovingkindness and upholding our souls in difficulty. Help us to rely more on Your word and to bring this comfort to others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense the lovingkindness in God’s promises in every difficulty, and find peace and fulfillment of heart in His comfort. Amen!

v: With the merciful, you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
b: This verse reveals God’s promise and principle: He treats with the same attitude those who live out His heart. When we treat others with lovingkindness, we become an extension of God’s lovingkindness, and He answers us with the same lovingkindness; when we strive for perfection, His perfection is also revealed in our lives. This is not a transaction but a spiritual principle: when we live out His character, we experience His presence and grace more deeply.

It is like a mirror: when we face it with a smile, the mirror reflects the same smile. In the same way, when we treat those around us with lovingkindness and sincerity, God’s lovingkindness fills our lives all the more, and we sense His reality and abundance.

There was a sister named Lin Meiling who often helped lonely elderly people in her neighborhood, delivering meals, chatting with them, and even helping them solve some problems of daily life. Her lovingkindness was not just action but came from her love for God. Once she prepared a hot meal for an elderly woman, who was so moved that she wept and said, “Your love makes me feel that God really cares about me.” Meiling sensed that it was not just her own action but God showing His lovingkindness through her hands. In striving to love others as herself, she herself also understood God’s lovingkindness toward her more deeply.
Meiling’s story reminds us that when we treat others with lovingkindness, we not only bless them but also make our own lives richer, because more of God’s lovingkindness will come upon us.

Dear family, let us remember that each small act of lovingkindness can make us a vessel of God’s lovingkindness. When we treat others with lovingkindness, our lives will come closer to His heart and experience even greater blessing from Him.
a: List of Lovingkindness
Write down someone you can help, and plan one concrete action, such as bringing a meal, making a phone call, or praying for them.
Weekly Encouragement Cards
Prepare some small cards with encouraging words and give them at random to people who need care, letting them feel your love.
Community Service
Take part in a community activity, whether cleaning up the neighborhood or visiting elderly people who live alone, and show God’s lovingkindness through your actions.
Daily Lovingkindness Challenge
Do one unconditional good deed each day, such as helping a mother push her cart at the supermarket or bringing a thoughtful gift to a neighbor.
Family Moment of Lovingkindness
Share a passage of Scripture with your family and plan a shared act of lovingkindness, such as donating items to people in need.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for treating us with lovingkindness, so that we too can treat others with lovingkindness. Give us a tender heart and help us to be an extension of Your lovingkindness, so that more people will sense Your grace through our actions. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you treat those around you with lovingkindness every day, and find fulfillment and joy in God’s abundant lovingkindness. Amen!

v: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
b: This verse shows a prayer from deep fellowship with God: asking God to revive our lives with His lovingkindness so that we can more attentively keep His word. When we experience weakness or difficulty, God’s lovingkindness comes like welcome rain on a thirsty field, pouring new strength and hope into us. We are revived not to remain in grace but to keep His statutes more firmly and live out His heart.

It is like a withered plant that needs sunshine and rain to come to life again. In the same way, our spiritual lives need the shining of God’s lovingkindness and the watering of His grace to be revived from weariness, regain strength, and become witnesses to His good purpose.

There was a brother named Liu Zhipeng who lost his steady job when his company laid off staff, and long-term pressure left his spirit parched. He felt he had lost his direction in life, and even his faith began to waver. In one prayer he begged for God’s help, asking His lovingkindness to touch his heart again. A few days later he read this verse in his Bible reading and was deeply moved. He began to pray attentively every day and entrusted his plans to God. Before long he found a new job, and his heart also recovered peace and joy. Zhipeng shared, “It was God’s lovingkindness that revived me, so that I am no longer lost and have learned again to trust Him.”

Zhipeng’s story reminds us that, whatever difficulty we face, as long as we cry out to God, His lovingkindness becomes our strength. After we are revived, we should keep His word with even more zeal and become witnesses to His glory.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the source of our life every day. In any circumstance we can call on Him and be strengthened anew in His grace.
a: Prayer for Spiritual Revival
Spend ten minutes alone with God each day, tell Him your needs, and ask His lovingkindness to give you new strength.
Write Down Goals for His Statutes
Choose a verse as your action goal for the week, and record how you practice its teaching each day.
Journal of Refreshing the Soul
Record over one week how God has revived your spirit through His lovingkindness, give thanks, and share it with others.
List of Grace
List five graces from God that you have experienced lately, and make them the subject of your prayers with a thankful heart.
Practical Help for Others
Find a friend or family member who needs support and become a “refresher” in their life, accompanying them through their difficulty with God’s love.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for reviving our lives with lovingkindness and renewing our strength in weakness. Help us to answer Your grace with thankful hearts and to keep Your word, so that our lives become a witness to You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience the reviving of God’s lovingkindness every day, may your life be full of the power of renewal, and may you find true freedom and fulfillment in keeping His statutes. Amen!

t: Hear Me According to Your Lovingkindness
v: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
b: This verse is the psalmist’s heartfelt cry to God, showing that we can seek His help and revival on the basis of God’s lovingkindness and His righteous ordinances. God’s lovingkindness is not merely a feeling but an action with power. He is glad to hear our voice and to carry out salvation according to His promises. When we are in trouble or our souls are parched, this verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is the assurance by which we can stand.

It is like a loving father who, whatever the situation in which his child cries out, responds at once, bringing help and comfort. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness in our lives will never lessen because our circumstances change.

There was a brother named Chen Weiren who, after a major setback, felt his life had lost its direction. His family and his work were both facing heavy challenges, and he wanted to give up. But during a time of quiet prayer he read this verse and was deeply moved. He began to cry out to God sincerely every day, asking His lovingkindness to hear him and lead him out of his predicament. Gradually his heart was no longer swallowed up by pressure but sensed peace and strength from God. In the end, he not only found work again but also experienced a revival of faith together with his family.
Chen Weiren’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is never far from us. He is glad to hear our prayers and to revive our souls with His truth and grace.

Dear family, whatever challenges we face, let us learn from the psalmist’s example and cry out earnestly to God. He is a God of faithful lovingkindness, glad to listen and to revive us according to His promises. Let us keep seeking Him and answer His love with thankful hearts.
a: Start a Prayer Journal
Each day, record your cries to God and write down His responses, helping you sense His hearing and lovingkindness.
Memorize Verses of Promise
Find several verses that record God’s promises, and meditate on His lovingkindness and salvation in times of difficulty.
Share Grace with Others
Whether with a friend or a family member, share your experience of God’s lovingkindness and encourage them also to entrust their lives to God.
Acts of Thanks
Each day, express thanks to someone who has helped you, and show them God’s lovingkindness through practical action.
Time of Quiet Meditation
Spend five to ten minutes in silence before God each day, listening to His voice and pouring out your needs and thanks to Him.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your mercy and lovingkindness, for always being glad to hear our voice, and for reviving our souls with Your ordinances. Help us to keep calling on You in difficulty and to be sure that Your lovingkindness and salvation never change. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s hearing and saving lovingkindness every time you call on Him, and find new life and direction in His ordinances. Amen!

t: Save Me According to Your Lovingkindness
v: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness,
b: This verse is the psalmist’s sincere prayer to God, expressing complete dependence on His lovingkindness. On life’s journey it is inevitable that we meet moments of helplessness and low points. Yet this verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is our greatest support, that we can cry out to Him without reservation, and that He will surely save us in lovingkindness and open a way for us.

It is like a ship that has lost its way on a dark night, when suddenly a lighthouse lights up and shows the safe channel. God’s lovingkindness is that lighthouse. When we feel lost or distressed, it brings us hope and direction and lets us escape our predicament.

There was a sister named Lin Peiyun who faced a great challenge in her marriage. Because of mutual misunderstandings, she and her husband often quarreled and even considered separating. When she felt helpless, she decided to bring it all before God, praying, “Lord, help me, and save my marriage according to Your lovingkindness.” As she kept praying, Peiyun gradually sensed God’s love giving her more patience, and she began to treat her husband with kindness and tolerance. God’s lovingkindness also touched her husband, communication between them grew better and better, and in the end their marriage was not only restored but made even stronger.

Peiyun’s testimony reminds us that, whether the difficulty is in marriage, family, or work, when we choose to call on God, He supports us with hands of lovingkindness and leads us out of the valley into a fuller life.

Dear family, when you feel helpless or in need of help, remember that God’s lovingkindness is always beside you. Let us trust Him fully, because He is glad to help and save us. May we experience His loving presence every day.
a: Prayer Schedule
Each day, pray about one difficulty or challenge, focusing on asking for God’s lovingkindness and salvation, and record His guidance and answers.
Thankful Calling Out
Look back on times in your life when God helped you with lovingkindness, write down your thanks, and share the experience with others to be a blessing.
Form an Intercession Group
Form a group with friends or family to pray for one another and witness to God’s wonderful work in one another’s lives.
Acts of Help
Take the initiative to help a friend or stranger in trouble, becoming the hands and feet of God’s lovingkindness so that they feel His love.
Time of Meditation
Spend ten minutes in quiet each day, reflect on God’s lovingkindness in your life, and tell Him your needs and thanks.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being a God full of lovingkindness and mercy, always glad to hear our cry and to save us with Your love. Help us not to lose heart in difficulty, and to rely on Your lovingkindness in faith, so that our lives are full of Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense the support of God’s lovingkindness every time you call on Him, and, because of His salvation, may your life be full of peace and joy. Amen!

v: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
b: In Psalm 23, David praises God’s goodness and lovingkindness with deep feeling, comparing God’s companionship to that of a loving shepherd. This verse especially reminds us that, whatever our surroundings, God’s goodness and lovingkindness follow us like a shadow at every moment. This lasting, unconditional lovingkindness brings us strength and comfort, and gives us assurance that in God we have an eternal home.

It is like a mother who, wherever her child is, always watches over him carefully, and whether the child is happy or sad, her love goes with him. God’s lovingkindness is deeper than a mother’s love: He not only accompanies us but also prepares an eternal dwelling for us, so that we may live securely in His presence.

There was a brother named Chen Shihong who in his youth left his hometown because of family problems and struggled alone in the city. Even when he met setbacks, he always remembered the prayer his mother taught him in childhood. He said, “Whenever I pray, I feel that God’s lovingkindness has never left me, and His grace always appears just when I need it most.” Later, Shihong’s life gradually got on track, and he said with feeling, “God’s lovingkindness is like the stars in the night sky. Even when you can’t see them, you know they are always there, lighting the way ahead for me.”

Shihong’s story reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is the most dependable support in our lives. When we choose to walk with Him, His goodness and lovingkindness become the best blessing in our lives.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness always follows us. It not only keeps us but leads us into His abundance. May we always be thankful, and let this lovingkindness be the strength and hope of our lives.
a: Daily Thank-You Card
Record the moments of the day in which you experienced God’s lovingkindness, such as receiving unexpected help or inner peace.
Encouragement on the Go
Carry a card with a Bible verse, and when you feel weary or confused, take it out and meditate on God’s goodness and lovingkindness.
Take Part in Church Life
Set aside time to take an active part in church worship or a small group, and taste the joy and peace of dwelling in God’s house.
Acts of Companionship
Take the initiative to accompany someone who needs care, and, as God’s lovingkindness accompanies us, be a blessing in their life.
Daily Psalm Devotion
Meditate on a psalm each day, and learn from David’s prayers how to build a deeper relationship with God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that Your lovingkindness follows us like a shadow, bringing us peace and hope. Help us to live with thankful hearts and to pass Your goodness and lovingkindness on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live all the days of your life in God’s goodness and lovingkindness, and, because of His presence, may your heart be filled with peace and joy. Amen!

v: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
b: This verse reveals a precious spiritual truth: when we feel that we are falling and helpless, God’s lovingkindness is our pillar, and His hand never leaves us. His support is not only practical help but also comfort and strength in the spirit. As we walk the rugged road of life, this lovingkindness becomes the motivation that lifts us up again, leading us to a peaceful and secure future.

It is like the rope for climbers scaling a steep peak, which protects and supports them. Even if they misstep for a moment, the rope holds them firmly and does not let them fall. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is the safety rope of our lives, holding us up so that we are not struck down by hardship.

There was a sister named Li Shufen who, hit by both financial hardship and family pressure, felt her life had come to an end. Once, as she knelt weeping in prayer before God, a sense of peace and hope suddenly rose in her heart. Soon afterward she received a letter from a friend she had not been in touch with for many years. In it the friend not only encouraged her but also offered to help her through her predicament. Shufen deeply sensed that this was God holding her up with His lovingkindness and letting her find strength for living again.
Shufen’s testimony reminds us that, however low the valley in which we fall, as long as we call on God, His lovingkindness will hold us up and pull us back into His arms.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the pillar of our lives. He watches over us at every moment and holds us up when we need it most. Whatever challenge we meet, may we go forward in faith, relying on His lovingkindness.
a: Reflection of Thanks
Each day, review the difficulties and challenges of the day and record how God’s support was shown in you.
Seek Support
Share your struggles with a spiritual friend or church leader and pray together, sensing the lovingkindness God gives through His people.
Help Those Who Have Fallen
Notice those near you who need help and become a channel of God’s lovingkindness to help them stand again.
Acts of Encouragement
Encourage a friend facing a low point with a letter or a message, bringing them hope and comfort.
Daily Meditation
Choose a psalm to meditate on, paying special attention to how God’s lovingkindness holds us up, and bring that feeling into your prayers.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for holding us up with lovingkindness when we fall. Help us to rely on Your strength in hard times and to pass Your lovingkindness on to those in need. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God’s lovingkindness hold you up every time you fall, give you strength to stand again, and fill your heart with peace and hope. Amen!

v: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
b: This verse reminds us that when we keep looking to God’s lovingkindness and keep His grace always in our hearts, our lives will naturally walk in His truth. God’s lovingkindness is not only a comfort in our hearts but also a guide for how we live, helping us hold to integrity in a complicated world and live out His glory.

It is like sunshine that is always shining on the earth. Although we cannot see the sun itself at every moment, its light lets us tell direction and feel warmth. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is like spiritual sunlight, lighting up our lives and leading us to walk in His truth.

There was a sister named Lin Shuwen who often faced decisions in the workplace. Once, because she insisted on honesty and refused to take part in an unethical business practice, she was isolated. Although the pressure was great, she kept meditating on God’s lovingkindness and sought His guidance in prayer. As a result, because she held to the truth, she gained her supervisor’s trust, and not only kept her position but was promoted to the company’s core team. She said, “When I focus on God’s lovingkindness, my heart can be unafraid and not stray from the right path.”
Shuwen’s story reminds us that when we keep God’s lovingkindness before our eyes, He becomes our strength and shield and helps us face the challenges of life.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the light of our lives, helping us walk in His truth. Whatever our circumstances, may we rely on His lovingkindness and live out His will.
a: Daily Meditation on Lovingkindness
Spend five minutes each day quietly thinking about God’s lovingkindness, and review the grace and protection you experienced during the day.
Plan for Acting on Truth
List specific actions by which you can practice God’s truth in your life, whether in the family, at work, or at church.
Encourage a Companion
Encourage a brother or sister to keep God’s lovingkindness in mind, share your own experience, and support one another in walking in the truth.
Reminder of Lovingkindness
Place a small object, such as a cross or a Scripture card, at home or on your desk to remind you at any time to look to God’s lovingkindness.
Answer the Truth with Love
Today, deliberately do something loving for someone in difficulty, showing God’s lovingkindness and truth through your actions.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us lovingkindness and truth to be the light for our walk through life. Help us to focus on Your lovingkindness and, guided by truth, to live a life that pleases You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you always look to God’s lovingkindness, walk steadily in His truth, and be full of peace and joy. Amen!

v: Whoever is wise, let him pay attention to these things. Let them consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
b: This verse tells us that God’s lovingkindness is the cornerstone of a wise life. Wise people pay attention to God’s lovingkindness in every detail and keep those experiences in mind, thereby growing in faith and gratitude. Considering God’s lovingkindness not only lets us know His works but also helps us worship Him more deeply and learn to treat others with the same lovingkindness.

It is like a farmer who, after sowing, keeps watching the weather, because he knows the harvest depends on the nourishment of sun and rain. In the same way, we need to observe carefully in daily life and notice how God nourishes our souls with His lovingkindness, and through such consideration come to rely on Him more.

There was a brother named Liu Jianxun who felt unable to bear the double pressure of family and work. But he began, in his morning prayers each day, to recall God’s past graces and to record His lovingkindness in a diary. Gradually he discovered that even in the hardest days God’s lovingkindness had never been absent. He said, “When I consider God’s lovingkindness, my heart is no longer controlled by circumstances but is filled with His peace.”
Jianxun’s story reminds us that when we often consider God’s lovingkindness, we can draw faith and strength from it and face life with a more positive attitude.
Dear family, let us remember that a wise life begins with considering God’s lovingkindness. May we often pay attention to His works and answer His endless love with thankful hearts.
a: Diary of Observing Lovingkindness
Each day, record the works of God’s lovingkindness in your life, such as times of being kept and comforted, and build up your list of thanks.
Time for Wise Meditation
Spend fifteen minutes each day meditating on stories of God’s lovingkindness in the Bible, such as the return of the prodigal son or the love of the cross, and apply them to your life.
Share Lovingkindness with Others
Tell those around you how you have experienced God’s lovingkindness, helping them also come to know this unconditional love.
Meditate Through Song
Choose a worship song, and as you sing, meditate on the parts of the lyrics that mention God’s lovingkindness, letting music draw your heart closer to God.
Lovingkindness Prayer Group
Form a group with a few friends, share each week your experiences of considering God’s lovingkindness, and offer prayers of thanks for them.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for guiding us with Your endless lovingkindness. Help us to pay attention to Your works and to consider Your lovingkindness, and to live each day with wisdom and gratitude. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see God’s lovingkindness in your thoughts every day, and live a life of wisdom and gratitude in His grace. Amen!

v: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindnesses, for they are from old times.
b: This verse brings us great comfort, reminding us that God’s compassion and lovingkindness are eternal and unchanging, shown in His people from ancient times. When we face weakness, difficulty, or failure, we can pray to God and ask Him to remember His never-ending lovingkindness. His love is not as changeable as human feelings but eternal and firm, and He is glad to forgive and receive us and lead us back into His embrace.

It is like a deep river: even if we cannot see its source, its water keeps flowing without end, watering the land along its banks. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is like this river, flowing into our lives from ancient times to eternity, nourishing our souls and bringing strength and hope.

There was a sister named Chen Zihan who was discouraged and in pain because of a family conflict that had gone unresolved for many years. One day, while reading the Bible, she was touched by God’s compassion and lovingkindness, and she began to change the way she prayed. She no longer prayed only for the conflict to be resolved but asked God to help her treat her family with love and patience, and she remembered His past graces in her life. Slowly her family sensed her change and also began to put aside their prejudices and open their hearts to one another. The experience made Zihan understand that God’s lovingkindness had never left; it only needed us to respond actively and remember His works.
Zihan’s story reminds us that when we choose to remember God’s compassion and lovingkindness, our hearts are filled with His love, bringing restoration to relationships and renewal to life.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s compassion and lovingkindness are the greatest assurance in our lives. May we learn to count His graces, remember His unchanging love, and walk each day with thankful hearts.
a: Journal of Lovingkindness
Each day, record how God’s compassion and lovingkindness appeared in your life, such as a time of help, protection, or inner encouragement.
Prayer of Remembrance
Write God’s past graces in your life as a prayer of thanks and read it again and again, reminding yourself that God’s lovingkindness has endured from ancient times.
Pass On Love
Choose someone with whom you have had a misunderstanding or distance, take the initiative to show care for them, and let God’s lovingkindness be passed on through you.
Sharing Testimonies of Lovingkindness
Share in a small group or with your family how you have experienced God’s compassion and lovingkindness, to inspire others to trust Him.
Compose a Psalm of Lovingkindness
Describe God’s lovingkindness in your life in a song or in writing, and offer it as a sacrifice of praise to God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your compassion and lovingkindness that have lasted from ancient times and never forsake us. Help us to remember Your grace and let this love fill our hearts, so that we live out Your purpose. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often remember God’s lovingkindness and find heavenly peace and joy in this love. Amen!

v: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
b: This verse reminds us that trusting in God’s lovingkindness is a choice of the heart. When we choose to believe in His lovingkindness, our lives can go from worry to joy. God’s lovingkindness is not a passing comfort but eternal support, helping us find peace and the joy of salvation in every circumstance.

It is like a tree rooted deep beside a stream. In drought or storm, it can rely on the nourishment the stream provides and stay strong. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is the stream of our lives, and whatever difficulty we meet, we can draw strength from His love.

There was a sister named Chen Lifen who was a full-time mother and had long been exhausted by the pressure of her children’s schooling. Once, when her child’s final grades fell short of expectations, she was filled with self-reproach and anxiety, thinking she had not fulfilled her responsibility in educating her child. One evening, in prayer, she poured out her weariness and helplessness to God and asked His lovingkindness to help her out of this predicament. In prayer she sensed God saying to her, “Do not worry. The child is Mine, and I will lead you forward.”

Afterward, Lifen learned to accompany her child with more patience and to commit the results to God. She began to focus on her child’s strengths and to encourage the child to face challenges with a joyful attitude. Gradually the child’s attitude toward study improved, and the atmosphere in the home was filled with more harmony and love.
Lifen’s testimony tells us that when we choose to trust in God’s lovingkindness, not only is our own heart set free, but our family and relationships can also come alive anew through God’s salvation.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is our greatest support. When we trust in His love, our hearts can rejoice in His salvation and fear no challenge.
a: Journal of Trust
Each day, record one thing that worries you and commit it to God in prayer, and watch how He leads you to experience His lovingkindness.
Learn Patience
Spend time learning to treat the people around you, whether family, friends, or coworkers, with love and patience, putting God’s lovingkindness into practice.
Exercise in Praise
Each day, offer God thanks for the salvation you have experienced in your life, and share His love as you walk with others.
Pass On Lovingkindness
Choose someone going through difficulty and offer your care and help, passing God’s lovingkindness on through practical action.
Time with Your Children
If you are a parent, set aside time just for your child, not to talk about grades or to scold, but simply to express love, so that your child feels God’s love flowing through you.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making lovingkindness the pillar of our lives. Help us to trust in Your lovingkindness, to find joy and peace in Your salvation, and to share this love with more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you trust in God’s lovingkindness every day, and may your life be filled with peace and joy. Amen!

v: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
b: This verse tells us that God’s lovingkindness is like an invisible safety net, always covering those who fear Him and hope in His lovingkindness. His eyes not only watch over our needs but also hold us up with lovingkindness when we are weak. To hope in God’s lovingkindness means to believe that His heart is good and to rely on Him as our help at all times.

It is like sunshine that is always shining on the earth. Although we cannot see it, its warmth nourishes all things at every moment. In the same way, when we hope in God’s lovingkindness, His care becomes the deepest comfort and strength in our lives.

There was a brother named Yang Zihua who loved outdoor adventures. Once, while climbing a high mountain, he met a sudden snowstorm and was separated from his teammates. He was stranded on the mountainside, the temperature dropped sharply, and all around was a blur of white. He remembered his daily devotions, knelt down and prayed to God, looking to His lovingkindness. After praying, he felt an unusual peace in his heart and gained the strength to get through the long night. The next morning the rescue team found him. In his testimony Zihua said, “That night I understood deeply that when we hope in God’s lovingkindness, His eyes are always watching over us, and He gives us protection.”

Zihua’s experience reminds us that God’s lovingkindness does not diminish because of difficult circumstances. Whatever hardship we are in, as long as we fear Him and look to Him, His eyes will surely watch over us.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is our help and protection at all times. When we hope in His lovingkindness, our lives will be full of confidence and peace, and we will fear no challenge.
a: Daily Prayer and Worship
Each morning, look to God’s lovingkindness, pray for His guidance and care, and offer Him reverence and thanks in prayer.
Journal of Faith
Record each day a story of experiencing God’s lovingkindness and care, such as how He led you through a challenge or kept you from harm.
Acts of Support
Take the initiative to care for those going through difficulty, becoming a “watcher” in their lives, reflecting God’s lovingkindness through your love and care.
Devotions in Nature
Arrange a quiet outdoor devotion, observe the traces of lovingkindness in God’s creation, such as the warmth of the sun or the touch of the breeze, and sense His care more deeply.
Time of Intimate Prayer
Set up a daily prayer time with your family, share your needs in life with one another, and look to God’s lovingkindness together.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for watching over our lives with lovingkindness. Help us, in each day’s life, to learn to fear You and look to You, and to receive peace and strength from Your lovingkindness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s watchful lovingkindness every day, and receive strength and hope under His protection. Amen!

v: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
b: This verse tells us that God’s pleasure comes from those whose hearts are full of reverence and who still hope in His lovingkindness in difficulty. This hope is not passive waiting but trust and expectation, because we know that God is the faithful and loving Lord, and His grace will surely come upon us.

It is like a farmer who, after sowing, waits patiently for the rain, because he believes the Heavenly Father will give rain in its season. In the same way, when we commit the longings of our hearts to God, He will answer us with His lovingkindness at the right time and make our lives abundant.

There was a sister named Chen Yaxin who once faced a crisis in her marriage. Her husband had grown cold because of work pressure, and their relationship was at a standstill. Yaxin did not give up but revered God in prayer every day and hoped that His lovingkindness could change it all. She did not force her husband to change but treated him with a gentle attitude and unconditional love. A few months later, her husband apologized to her on his own and said that he too had felt the pressure ease and the marriage being restored. Yaxin said, “In that time, although I did not know when God would act, I knew He surely would.”
Yaxin’s story reminds us that when we hope in God’s lovingkindness, we can keep peace and faith during the time of waiting, because we know God’s lovingkindness never comes to nothing.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is our everlasting hope, and He delights in those who fear Him and rely on Him. Whatever challenge you are facing, place your hope in God’s lovingkindness, and He will answer you in His wonderful way.
a: Daily Prayer of Reverence
Each morning, give thanks for God’s lovingkindness, make your requests to Him, and offer Him praise with a heart of reverence.
Small Note of Faith
Write down one thing you are waiting for God to answer and put it where you will see it every day, to remind yourself to hope in His lovingkindness.
Acts of Care
Take the initiative to care for a friend going through difficulty, pray for them, and encourage them to put their hope in God’s lovingkindness.
Exercise in Seeds of Hope
Buy a plant seed, plant it yourself, and watch it grow, reminding yourself to hope patiently for God’s work while you wait.
Sharing Hope
Share with family or fellowship the moments in which you experienced God’s lovingkindness, helping one another build faith and hope.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for delighting in us because of our reverence and hope. Help us to be full of faith while we wait, and to believe firmly that Your lovingkindness will come to us at the best time. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hope in God’s lovingkindness every day, and find peace and fulfillment in His promises. Amen!
